clean_body: President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act will lower prescription drug, health insurance, and utility costs, and fight inflation. | | | Peter -- this week, President Biden and Democrats celebrated the historic passage of the Inflation Reduction Act. President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act will lower prescription drug, health insurance, and utility costs, and fight inflation -- all while reducing the federal deficit and finally making big corporations and billionaires pay their fair share. And the best part? Middle-class families making below $400,000 won’t pay a dime more in taxes under it. Democrats beat the wealthy special interests to deliver for American families, while Republicans are doing their bidding and opposing efforts to lower costs. We’ve created a personal link for your message, Peter. Take a moment to watch President Biden’s video to you and, if you can, chip in $25 to support Democrats nationwide in 2022 and beyond. Thanks, The Democrats \-----Forwarded message----- Sender: President Joseph R. Biden, Jr. Date: Tue, September 13, 2022 Subject: I know you haven’t donated yet this year to support our party, Peter -- so I need you to step up for the first time: Peter, great news! Last month, I signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law, something that would not have been possible without the help of this grassroots team. Today, we’re celebrating the Inflation Reduction Act’s passage here in D.C. As a key supporter, I wanted you to hear directly from me about the progress we’ve made together. | | | The bottom line is that I ran for president promising to make government work for working families again -- and that’s exactly what Democrats are doing. This win is just as much yours as it is mine, which is why I wanted to be sure you got to hear directly from me today while we celebrate in our nation’s capital. Thank you for being a part of this. Joe Joseph R. Biden, Jr. President of the United States | |

name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: This is How We Will Win
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_how_we_will_win&n=1)
---
Peter \-- **If you want to be politically respected, you must be politically feared!** That's the line we teach to our grassroots activists at our popular Real Nature of Politics training course. And it's 100% true! The Political Class fears you and me. Because for the first time, in a long time, a well organized, conservative grassroots movement has propelled to the forefront of Minnesota politics. Politicians' voting records and corrupt tactics are being exposed!!! That's what makes us unique in the political landscape in this state. We aren't afraid to get in the mud and fight. Our tenacity was on full display at the MN State Fair. The **Dump Walz** booth was so popular that we ran out of most items by Day 11. **In total, we:** **1\. Brought in tens of thousands of new activists to our movement** **2\. Got our message out to MILLIONS of voters who either walked by our booth, saw us on social media or saw us covered in the news.** **3\. Armed countless amounts of pissed off voters with how Tim Walz has DESTROYED Minnesota!** Just look how MPR was forced to cover us in a segment with Scott Jensen and Tim Walz: [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=WcqDquHB9nQO44q6aiUb4OCRNe-PwOM1iZcB6vZpAgKnXWS-yiZYUAhi0VuWlpc1bJj5uGlL5vUDQFPbOnc9oUZKExCf6bbXLc8i_8SKtyEDgmCq2trrAQvabDvGIj8J&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_how_we_will_win&n=2) But the Democrats and their buddies in the Corporate Media are in full-on campaign mode. It's time for them to unload their propaganda campaigns, hit pieces, phony polls and everything else to trick voters into voting blue. They'll resort to straight up lies and slander to win. We've seen this play out a thousand times in the last two years. What they want to do is make us all forget about what Tim Walz and the Radicals did to us. But we're not going to let that go unanswered. **I need your help to continue the momentum we built at the State Fair. Help us get our message out to more Minnesotans over the next two months.** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_how_we_will_win&n=3 "YES! I'd like to Help") [YES! I'd like to Help](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_how_we_will_win&n=3)
---
The next two months will be very important in this fight to Save Minnesota...and our country.
I am sick and tired of seeing the destruction that has been caused.
During COVID, Walz abused Emergency Powers to lock us in our homes and shut down businesses.
**He is DESTROYING business in Minnesota.**
Walz also took our children out of schools, made them wear masks and harmed early development. Now test scores are dropping.
**Walz is DESTROYING our children's education.**
And after George Floyd's death, he allowed rioters and looters to burn down the 3rd Precinct. Crime rates are spiking to unforeseen levels in Minneapolis and St Paul. People no longer want to visit or do business.
**Walz is DESTROYING our cities.**
You might wonder how a politician with this record could ever stand a chance to win re-election.
Well, millions of dollars of Special Interest money is flooding into this state to distort Walz' record and attack Scott Jensen.
And...as I mentioned above...the Corporate Media will do everything they can to trick voters into believing Walz is doing a good job.
That's why our mission is SO IMPORTANT!
Action 4 Liberty pulls no punches. We hit politicians where it hurts the most.
Our ability to reach voters throughout Minnesota is unparalleled and critical to setting the record straight.
If these are the lines we can pull for 12 days at the MN State Fair...
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_how_we_will_win&n=4)
...just imagine the IMPACT you can help us make over the next two months!
Our objective is to EXPOSE Walz' record to every single voter in Minnesota. And that's where I need your help.
[**Please help me continue this important objective with a $25, $50, $100 or even $500 donation donation TODAY.**](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_how_we_will_win&n=5)
Stay tuned.
We are going to be releasing a big component of our plan to hold Walz accountable in the coming weeks.
**In Liberty,**
****
**Jake Duesenberg**
**President, Action 4 Liberty**
Action 4 Liberty
1920 Oakcrest Ave #5
Roseville, MN 55113

Hispanic Heritage Month kicks off today, Peter, and I am SO excited. **I’m proud to be a Latina running to represent Colorado – a state where a Latina has never been elected to Congress.**

This is a time to celebrate the accomplishments of Hispanics and Latinos and how much they have contributed to our country. **Diversity is our strength, and every day is a reminder of that.**

My parents came to Colorado from a small town in Mexico, looking for a better life. They didn’t have much education or much money, but they knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my three siblings with those values – on a construction worker’s pay in the Adams County home they still live in – doing whatever it took to put us on a path to success.

**Within our communities, no two stories are the same.** As a Latina, I am proud of my story, and as a State Legislator, I am proud of my reputation for taking on tough fights and working with anyone to get things done. In Congress, I will continue tackling the biggest problems affecting our community, and will always be an advocate for Hispanic and Latino people.

I hope you’ll join me in reflecting on the contributions Hispanics and Latinos have made to our country. Thank you for reading this note and for being part of my story.

– Yadira

My parents came to Colorado from a small town in Mexico, looking for a better life. They didn’t have much education or much money, but they knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my three siblings with those values – on a construction worker’s pay in the Adams County home they still live in – doing whatever it took to put us on a path to success. Within our communities, no two stories are the same. As a Latina, I am proud of my story, and as a State Legislator, I am proud of my reputation for taking on tough fights and working with anyone to get things done. In Congress, I will continue tackling the biggest problems affecting our community, and will always be an advocate for Hispanic and Latino people. I hope you’ll join me in reflecting on the contributions Hispanics and Latinos have made to our country. Thank you for reading this note and for being part of my story. – Yadira P.S. Did you see our message?!
#
Peter,
I’m checking in with you because I wanted to make sure you saw this message from our team yesterday. Do you have 2 minutes to read it now?
**We set a goal to reach 350 donations by MIDNIGHT tonight and honestly, we’re getting close** – that’s why I’m reaching out to see if you can help us cross the finish line.
_"These upcoming deadlines are even more important because fundraising during the summer has been slow. So, we really need to hit our goals this month, Peter."_ [**So, Peter, can you contribute to Pramila’s campaign today and help us battle for control of Congress? We can only hit our mid-month goal with your help.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17278?refcode=em20220915-1625&t=1&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS) **[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17278?refcode=em20220915-1625&t=2&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS)**
---
While some of our fundraising numbers have dropped recently, I have faith in our grassroots base to come through and support Pramila. With less than two months to go until elections on November 8th, every day and every donation count.
It’s folks like you that power Pramila’s critical work as she pushes our progressive agenda forward and campaigns for key candidates across the country. [**Can we count on your support today to help us reach 350 donations by midnight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17278?refcode=em20220915-1625&t=3&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS)
Together,
Lauren Lalonde,
Campaign Manager, Pramila for Congress
* * *
Peter,
We’re nearing the end of September — that means a few things.
First, it means we’re heading into the final weeks before the midterms. These will be critical for (1) Pramila’s re-election campaign in Washington’s 7th Congressional District, (2) our work to help elect Democrats in swing districts, so that we can hold onto our Democratic majority, and (3) Pramila’s continued work to elect people-first progressives, so we can grow support for Medicare for All and other bold, transformative policies in Congress.
It also means we’re headed to our end-of-quarter FEC filing deadline. It’s the last time before the general election that we’ll be publicly sharing our fundraising numbers. Influential folks in the media and Washington D.C. will look at our numbers to see the strength of Pramila’s progressive campaign.
[**To stay on track for the FEC deadline, we’re launching a mid-month goal to hit 350 donations before 11:59 p.m. tomorrow night. Can you chip in $3 to fuel Pramila’s electoral work and help us stay on track?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17278?refcode=em20220915-1625&t=4&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17278?refcode=em20220915-1625&t=23&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS)**
These upcoming deadlines are even more important because fundraising during the summer has been slow. So, we really need to hit our goals this month, Peter.
And you know we rely on grassroots funding to run our campaign. Pramila would not be able to do this work without you.
The only way we can achieve our goals this year and in the future is if we hold our Democratic majority and grow our Congressional Progressive Caucus. Your support right now will help us do the critical electoral work in WA-7 and beyond.
[**So, Peter, can you contribute to Pramila’s campaign today and help us battle for control of Congress? We can only hit our mid-month goal with your help.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17278?refcode=em20220915-1625&t=24&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS)
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20220915-1625-footer&t=25&refcode2=1625_420207_6ytCXS&akid=1625%2E420207%2E6ytCXS)**

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of 3, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring _**real change**_ to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty earned as an active duty service member, and I **won**.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to advocate for all veterans, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

_**[Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298078:J3etVhVaN:m:1:3317145305:F21901746E50A8A12D259A7A7F86A140:r "Now, I need
your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat
opponent Patty Murray.")**_

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I'm getting nervous. We're finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

name: Senator Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this all the way through
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Patriot,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than sixty days until the Election and we're falling behind our Mid-Month Goal.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.**

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r " alias=")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.
****[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298601:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |

* * *
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298602:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "POLLS TIED!") I'm not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 100 days until the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls.

I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. Far-Left progressive groups are pouring in millions of dollars to try to win this Senate seat. The truth is, **I will lose if I don 't have your support.**

Please, Patriot, I'm begging: **[Will you chip in right now?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298602:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "Will you chip in right now?")** | | [SEND IMMEDIATE HELP](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61298602:JAGx-hVNx:m:1:3299561967:A3C08D9DA1920D5D1042D2A1FACC8ED1:r "SEND IMMEDIATE HELP")

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmnlnvs5vd6h1ecch01dmcmr7p7pocg8oes8hp18_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob6cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf1cr4e9j69o3gmdgr8crnc3grdd9mm8rj3cbjcarjatlhehg74chjmcqn6opgeurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj5cr66upb4phlcapm6ptgmlin49fg)

_**My message to all Christians who love both Christ and liberty. Let us unite to spread the Gospel and make liberty win!**_

Friend,

Here is something you don't want to hear: **YOU, as a Christian, have an obligation to OPPOSE Big Government, taxation, and endless wars. **

Throughout history, tyranny's biggest enemies have been followers of Jesus Christ.

Christians with hearts on fire for both Christ and liberty founded this great country and have helped defeat totalitarian governments like the British Empire, the Soviet Union, and still lead the fight for liberty all over the world today.

[_**The Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) is a non-profit organization dedicated to making the _Christian_ case for a free society and free markets. Please help us spread our message by making a donation of $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or ANY amount here >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z3pj9j722ac2tisagr7r347hpfbd2n5501vn70lg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob6cdh2bs)

What does this obligation mean to you?

It means the world is counting on Christians to fight for liberty, spread the Gospel, and defeat Big Government.

You and I must teach fellow believers how Scripture and Jesus's teachings promote the ideas of peace, voluntary action, and oppose the use of force and theft.

Here are the TOP 5 reasons why Christians must oppose Big Government:

* **Big Government haunted Jesus 's life on Earth:** When King Herod learned of the birth of a Savior, he lashed out in anger, murdered his family members, and ordered the deaths of newborns in Bethlehem.

It was also the Empire that sentenced him to death on the Cross. Fortunately, we know Christ died on that Cross to forgive our sins and give us Eternal Life.

* **Governments despise the Christian faith:** Ever since the birth of the Christian church, our brothers and sisters in Christ have been persecuted for their beliefs. From the Disciples being hunted down and killed after Jesus's Ascension... to modern dictators who ban the practice of Christianity.

You and I must NEVER compromise on religious freedom and fight for it at all costs.

* **Governments wage wars against the wishes of God: **Our Lord is a God of peace. We must not allow tyrants to conduct unconstitutional wars, waste trillions of dollars, and destroy human life.

* **Christian values create free and prosperous societies:** The United States is one of the most successful countries in the world largely because it was founded on the Judeo-Christian values of individual freedom and cooperation. These values keep society functioning and thriving.

* **God teaches us NOT to steal:** Taxation is a form of theft. Governments steal our money, devalue our currencies, and create waste. Or worse... They enrich themselves at the expense of their citizens.

[_**The Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI) is making the Christian case for liberty ... but we need your help. I am launching a goal to raise $25,000 from online supporters in the next 48 hours. Please donate using one of these links to help us spread our message!**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zm4d01eeu3jddktld3hleth60qnjrmovpkoe3tvo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob6cdh2bs)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zehbkl8i355g8pllvk8tq76655jseb1sp4ac9ff8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob6cdh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1t810opgdcgatjii7ka8hof0vvsk0nldgvhghro_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob6cdh2bs)

I founded the Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI), so Christians can once again begin leading the fight for liberty in the United States.

You and I cannot surrender our country to socialists, Woke activists, and agents of Big Government. God has tasked us with fighting for liberty and justice while on Earth. This is a responsibility we have as mankind.

LCI is spreading our message by publishing content, including articles, videos, and podcasts that reach HUNDREDS of THOUSANDS of people each year. With your help, we can reach more people with our message of Christ's gift of salvation and the _Christian_ case for liberty.

However, I can't do this alone.

Please join me.

_**[You may not know me, friend, so let me share my story.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3p64fd94mop8kel57v9nle674de1horldnpct98_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob2c1h2bs "You may not know me, friend, so let me share my story.")**_

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of 3, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring _**real change**_ to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

>From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty earned as an active duty service member, and I **won**.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to advocate for all veterans, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

_**[Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zps8v51jact46t5rgvj8pmp758318ljlduoba7c8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cph64ob2c1h2bs "Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.")**_

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I'm getting nervous. We're finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

I can't believe it, but on Sept 18, Ben is turning 71!

body:
Peter, The food index increased 11.4% over the last year, the largest 12-month increase since May 1979.

Hi Peter,

The food index increased 11.4% over the last year, the largest 12-month increase since May 1979.

The price of food has consistently gone up over the past year. That includes hard-to-find baby food, which increased 12.6%. Eggs increased 39.8% and milk 17%. Meat, poultry and fish increased 8.8%.

The inflation crisis was caused and continues to grow by the Biden Administration's out-of-control spending, failed policies, and inability to solve disruptions to the supply chain. As Town Councilman, I cut or froze taxes in the last four budgets. As Congressman, I will continue to protect taxpayers by "doing more with less."

We’re all just trying to work hard, raise our kids, and make a better life for the next generation.

Securing our border isn’t rocket science.
During the Trump Administration, illegal border crossings were at record lows. Our borders and our sovereignty were respected. Plain and simple.
**But under the Biden Administration - who’s _begging_ the cartels to come into our country - there have been roughly _3.4 MILLION_ migrant encounters at our southern border.**
And here’s the real kicker: _President Trump even gave Biden and Kamala the resources to STOP this crisis from ever happening._
Kari’s seen firsthand that the materials we need to complete the wall are all right here in Arizona. See for yourself...
[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85257%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8a8Bh0yZrYueWZ5J0GREeA&sysid=1)

**_But Joe Biden has literally left these resources to ROT in the desert._**
Why? Because this crisis isn’t a crisis at all to Biden, Kamala, and the radical Democrats. _It’s a ploy to generate more Democrat “votes” for decades to come._
This governor’s race is about far more than Republicans vs. Democrats.
It’s about reclaiming our country’s sovereignty and ensuring **AMERICAN CITIZENS** are the ones deciding who represents us.
There’s no two ways about it [FNAME], we MUST finish President Trump’s wall.
**_Do you agree we need to finish President Trump’s wall to secure our border?_**
[**__[!] YES - I’ll make a contribution to help Kari Lake finish the wall [!]__**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85265%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Mohou4V7a9TIW6HIiCa8uA&sysid=1)
Sadly, what Biden and Kamala have done to our southern border isn’t _just_ a threat to election security or a humanitarian crisis...
...it’s also an unparalleled national security threat.
So far this year, an **unprecedented 66** people whose names appear on the **_terror watch list_** were stopped trying to cross the U.S.-Mexico border.
**_Which is why Governor Ron DeSantis told Kari he would even send National Guard Troops all the way from Florida to help her SECURE the border._**
**_Do you stand with Governor DeSantis and Kari Lake in their fight to finish President Trump’s Wall?_**
[**__[!] YES - I’ll contribute to stand with Governor DeSantis and Kari Lake [!]__**](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85266%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AcEkmx0lg5rLghpSGmH4VA&sysid=1)

---

[STAND WITH DESANTIS & LAKE](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85267%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lAEITbKU%2foGlgAyqDCn7iA&sysid=1)

Arizona is the KEY to stopping Biden and Kamala’s border crisis. _In fact, it’s the ONE race Republicans must win to secure the border._
President Trump knows it, Governor DeSantis knows it, and Kari Lake knows it.
It’s why Kari’s made it clear she’s willing to do whatever it takes to ensure we complete the wall.
_But with less than 2 months to go until Election Day, she’s counting on the help of patriots like YOU to finish the job and crush her radical Democrat opponent._

These next 8 weeks will go by fast . It's time to prepare yourself for Election Day on November 8th. Encourage your friends and family to register to vote and check their registration status. When we all vote, we win!
Make my voting plan [bit.ly/NPPVotePA]

New Pennsylvania Project ramps up to make fall voting accessible to all | WHYY [https://whyy.org/articles/elections-new-pennsylvania-project-kadida-kenner-fall-voting-accessible-to-all/]
NPP CEO Kadida Kenner speaks with Cherri Gregg from WHYY 90.9 FM. Learn more about Kadida's background and NPP's mission to expand Pennsylvania's electorate so that it reflects the changing population in the commonwealth.
“There are 1.7 million people across this entire Commonwealth that need to be engaged and brought back into the electorate,” said Kenner, “[we are hearing] they just don’t believe that their vote is really counting for anything or they’re not in love with either political major party, and feel that their needs are not being met.”
After abortion ruling, Democratic numbers surge in Chester County | Daily Local News [https://www.dailylocal.com/2022/09/10/after-dobbs-democratic-numbers-surge-in-chester-county]
NPP CEO Kadida Kenner was recently featured in the Daily Local News discussing voter engagement in Chester County.
“The Dobbs ruling was a spark, especially for young women in Chester County to get engaged (in the election),” commented Kadida Kenner, chief executive officer of The New Pennsylvania Project, a West Chester-based voting rights organization. “As they saw their right to reproductive health being taken away by the court, they said, ‘Now I’m going to come out and do something about it.’” she said. “This is the time to come out (and vote) now.”
Mark Your Calendars!
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)

Pennsylvania Stakes Its Claim as Center of the Political Universe [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/02/us/politics/pennsylvania-midterm-elections.html] | Few states feature as many high-stakes, competitive races, each pulsing with the political currents that are shaping midterm campaigns across the country. (via The New York Times) [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/02/us/politics/pennsylvania-midterm-elections.html]

(via Politics PA) [https://www.politicspa.com/fivethirtyeight-10-election-deniers-on-pennsylvania-ballot-this-fall/111880/]
Ahead of pivotal 2022 Pa. election, Wolf administration expands access to voter registration forms [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-voter-registration-state-offices-wolf-order/] | Pennsylvania will now offer voter registration forms at libraries, state park offices, and state-run veterans homes, among other locations, as part of an enhanced effort to reach about 1.7 million people eligible to vote but who are not registered . (via Spotlight PA) [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/09/pa-election-voter-registration-state-offices-wolf-order/]

And several voters and political operatives doing on-the-ground outreach say his stance on abortion is a big reason why. (via WHYY) [https://whyy.org/articles/pennsylvania-suburban-voters-abortion-mastriano-election-2022/]
John Fetterman Calls on President Biden to Decriminalize Marijuana [https://keystonenewsroom.com/story/john-fetterman-calls-on-president-biden-to-decriminalize-marijuana/] | Ahead of Biden’s upcoming visit to Pittsburgh, Fetterman is calling on the President to work to deschedule marijuana from its classification as a Schedule I drug, and going on the offensive against his Senate opponent Dr. Oz in anticipation of any backlash . Tom Wolf’s request to hear his challenge of Republican-backed legislation that includes a proposal to amend the state constitution to say there is no right to abortion services in the commonwealth. name: Conservatives Give
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8d077d864d744f2db0d657954637f02b&_e=T-ljIteGNVYaAYV92iociadyxV0xmx4S72CUaNI9LnGk0WNun0qXrEQRk3PwKe5rcCBp0pjAFybxzZObHTMb-jNv90Rt3t3xGe492S8-u_x0tFzpLs1Lc2e_N2c3on8yNZc2a_j78zpxPkGenJme3NELb_5hT-2yOIZ95gWVosi_tEhVcno2RzRGbdciL2LtenTo-umw6gvCJ3EZLMZmynPEBLE91Un8s-YFLI1qzsghnv1dmRY9Yz7CWdyjiflgyXHc_qr5KzWbPZndDYevdp4jsxqk-6mWtM_8cmghylypP3u2gAH6D8ea2Ect2g5aOyVtIqjhe_LSjK1D5jE6qWcw6HrI7zMxtxOcK0t8Nmu4O9qPodsZu6_PqPKuVwdjQkJ-aCjsgbRx07qv8upvpQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8d077d864d744f2db0d657954637f02b&_e=T-ljIteGNVYaAYV92iociadyxV0xmx4S72CUaNI9LnGk0WNun0qXrEQRk3PwKe5rcCBp0pjAFybxzZObHTMb-jNv90Rt3t3xGe492S8-u_x0tFzpLs1Lc2e_N2c3on8yNZc2a_j78zpxPkGenJme3NELb_5hT-2yOIZ95gWVosi_tEhVcno2RzRGbdciL2LtenTo-umw6gvCJ3EZLMZmynPEBLE91Un8s-YFLI1qzshkRjep0Xxkuz3fhwEMfFkdXa3OaX2zyu-LQqw1oEb6czvBKUbF0Jg3t0PNfrVA2dg2tYR93kGzeBo2A98Qn2bSawjqqqt8tiX4tH5Edyc9rxo2mkh9wlfUgxCU6xMhR25XTO2AGiuicCgbpsObm_pZI4VIFochBRKsf0k2-0oMVA%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8d077d864d744f2db0d657954637f02b&_e=T-ljIteGNVYaAYV92iociadyxV0xmx4S72CUaNI9LnGk0WNun0qXrEQRk3PwKe5rcCBp0pjAFybxzZObHTMb-jNv90Rt3t3xGe492S8-u_x0tFzpLs1Lc2e_N2c3on8yNZc2a_j78zpxPkGenJme3NELb_5hT-2yOIZ95gWVosi_tEhVcno2RzRGbdciL2LtenTo-umw6gvCJ3EZLMZmynPEBLE91Un8s-YFLI1qzsgVrnMgnG8z-C1mFKA2n7iRijFCH3hEo96a7B-bRiv_bI2331vkxRMIpkfwF_8eA_gFMOEPKSnU1_iKoYv1OTS3Mob7Rt7MhC5Ye7OK3VmUuQBF0_EavClWRt0Iow8dQajXY6Uf50xfOV4l-ynq9-TEMC2gmcXXdz-3K-FRghS7JA%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Living with Aphasia
body:
Hi Derek,
11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to help him.
I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This one is going to be close.
Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. So, I’m asking:
Splitting $25 – or anything you can afford – between Mark's campaign and CommonGood will go a long way in helping Mark win re-election to continue fighting for the issues we care most about in the Senate. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220916_CGVA_Kelly]

My drive to improve things for the people of Arizona and our country has never been stronger. Mark is working so hard in the Senate to do that, and your support for him means the world to me.

Republicans only need to flip one seat to take back the U.S. Senate — and two of their top targets are my friends and colleagues Senator Catherine Cortez Masto (D-Nevada) and Senator Maggie Hassan (D-New Hampshire). Catherine and Maggie are both strong champions for abortion rights, and these elections are going to be tight: Maggie won her last race by just over 1,000 votes, Catherine won by just under 30,000 votes, and their polls are neck and neck this year. **National Republicans have tens of millions of dollars in the bank to spend on trying to defeat these two terrific Democratic senators. Catherine and Maggie are committed to ensuring the right to an abortion — and if we re-elect them this fall, expand our Senate majority by two more seats, and hold the House, we can make Roe the law of the land as early as January.
But they’re both running against anti-abortion rights extremists who fanned the flames of Donald Trump’s Big Lie after the 2020 election. And Mitch McConnell and his deep-pocketed allies will do everything they can to win these seats.
**We’ve got to stop Mitch McConnell from being majority leader again — and we’ve got to elect more champions for working people up and down the ballot.**

body:
Young Tennesseeans are faced with pregnancy, yet don’t have the ability to vote on their reproductive rights.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50803524/367239832/1141538894?refcode=EM_F_220916Teens_PC_BB_180DO180DC_4_NG_N_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZDBhOTYwYy1jYzM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OdYqeGMEKLJ3GuEfrc8peJfjYx98WYefvsoFNTk0FyM=) **Did you know that according to the CDC, Tennessee has the seventh highest incidence of teenage pregnancy in the country?**

Young Tennesseans are regularly faced with teenage pregnancy, yet they don’t have the ability to vote on their reproductive rights. When Roe v. subject: Campaign Update for you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
I spoke at a Giffords event — check it out!

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-sept?refcode=giffords [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-sept?refcode=giffords]
Dear Friends,
I recently had the honor of joining the Giffords Florida Bus Tour at one of their stops as they travel across Florida to highlight commonsense gun safety reform.
Giffords was founded by former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords after a gunman severely injured her in an assassination attempt. It is one of the largest organizations advocating for gun safety in the country.
I was so proud to earn their endorsement and to stand with them and with elected officials and activists across South Florida against the scourge of gun violence.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/96760/images/MOS-photos-3.png]
This is an issue that’s personal to me, friends. After our community experienced a school shooting at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School, I worked to pass the most comprehensive gun violence prevention, mental health, and school safety bill in Florida history.
Congress drew inspiration from our bill, and sent President Biden a bipartisan gun bill that expands background checks for gun purchasers under 21, strengthens laws on straw purchases and gun trafficking, and prevents domestic abusers from buying guns.
That bill was necessary, but not sufficient. We need more — like nationwide universal background checks, an increase of the age at which firearms may be purchased, and a ban on assault weapons.
In Congress, I will continue Congressman Deutch’s legacy so that Floridians always have an unwavering, outspoken voice for gun violence prevention, and I am committed to passing expanded gun violence prevention legislation.
Thanks,
Jared

Dear Friends & Neighbors, Nearing four decades of rising prices, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Tuesday that the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose to 8.3% in August over the last year. Inflation pressures are hitting everyone up and down the line. Where are our leaders? I feel the pressure and the stress each and every day. I know you are too. California families are hurting. With every day that passes, it’s even harder for the average family to afford to live in our state. The government’s role is to protect us, to help us grow, thrive and create wealth – the American dream. The average citizen no longer believes in that dream. With Federal and State policies that continue to raise prices, sadly most people are simply trying to make ends meet. We cannot afford two more years of rising prices and leaders in Washington not listening to us back home. My opponent is a professional politician, a tax and spend liberal who supports the Biden Administrations policies. We cannot afford to keep my opponent in office. It’s time for a change in leadership. If elected to Congress, I promise to fight to lower prices, not raise taxes. I’m a small businessman who understands the priority to keep a balanced budget and helping my clients to live a life within their means. I hope you join me in my campaign to take common-sense back to Congress. Your friend, Jeff

body:
it won’t be easy, but this is a fight we must win >>
| **Hi, my name is Charlie Crist, and I am the Democratic nominee for governor of Florida.**

My opponent? **_Gov. Ron DeSantis,_** one of the most dangerous Republicans nationwide.

Ron DeSantis has been using Florida as a testing ground for some of the most cruel and divisive culture war tactics of the last two years. He has been setting himself up as a likely presidential contender, and it's been working.

**Peter: Postmaster General Louis DeJoy is planning to cut 50,000 USPS jobs!**
Since practically day one on the job, DeJoy has failed our Postal Service.
In the midst of a pandemic when families were counting on the USPS more than ever, he cut services and slowed delivery times! **This led to absolute chaos – lost packages, unreasonable delays, and weakened trust in one of our most important public services.**
The USPS is a critical institution for millions of Americans. It keeps us connected. It makes sure we get our prescription medications. And it allows us to safely cast our ballots from home.
We cannot allow Louis DeJoy to weaken this cherished institution – especially in the months before a major election! **We need to show that Americans are united in _defense_ of our Postal Service and _against_ DeJoy's corner-cutting. I’m a veteran. I’m running for Congress. But I’m also a dad.

For me, that means:

— Stopping the NRA from paying politicians to vote down real gun safety legislation.

— Passing laws to protect our veterans and veteran families.

— Ousting Republicans who want to control reproductive rights.

**[Please believe me when I say: There has never been more on the line than in this election. I’m fighting for my family and yours, but I can’t do it alone — not when Tony Gonzales has nearly $2 million to use against me. We’ve set a goal to raise $5,000 before midnight to ensure we can continue our new canvassing program and spread the word about my campaign. It fills me with pride to celebrate our history, our culture, and our accomplishments. In El Paso and nationwide, the contributions of Hispanic Americans are undeniable.

From the farmers who keep us fed to the doctors who keep us healthy, Latinos are leading the way.

As we celebrate our achievements this month, we also keep our eyes on the future. We won't stop fighting for equal pay, universal healthcare, and humane immigration reform. Together, we can build an America that's equitable for all of our country's people — and I know Latinos will be at the forefront of that fight.

With pride,

Veronica
Veronica Escobar made history as one of the first Texas Latinas elected to serve in Congress. She's an outspoken advocate for El Paso's progressive values in Washington. That's put a target on her back from Trump supporters who are preparing to spend millions to end her leadership. Can we count on you to stand with Veronica?

name: American Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0706%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=65xCnxFOo7bZUAhuiYovHg&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33298%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mZFNifGXs6ywUFTAxTUhbQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33299%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=V0ClFF4td%2bLdQ9zz%2bVXIdQ&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33299%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=V0ClFF4td%2bLdQ9zz%2bVXIdQ&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

I will never - ever - stop standing up to extremist Republicans like Donald Trump and his Senate allies, like Mitch McConnell. Senator Rick Scott of Florida - chair of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, the GOP's fundraising powerhouse - is personally here in Connecticut to host a $25,000 per person dinner in support of my opponent.
**I won 't parse words: They are making this state, and this Senate seat, a target.**
**That 's why I must ask: [With Democratic Senate control on the line, will you please donate $5 or whatever you can to help me close this fundraising gap before our public FEC reporting deadline? It will take them just a single seat to succeed. Shifting political grounds have me even more concerned. I'm up against Donald Trump's hand-picked opponent. The RNC opened a new office in this state - christened by Trump acolyte and RNC Chairperson herself, Ronna McDaniel - and McDaniel returned there yesterday to campaign with my opponent. Senator Rick Scott of Florida - chair of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, the GOP's fundraising powerhouse - is personally here in Connecticut to host a $25,000 per person dinner in support of my opponent. I won 't parse words: They are making this state, and this Senate seat, a target. That 's why I must ask: Thanks for all you do. Dick

body:
Did you hear about this?

| | | |

**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
Even though I believe Dan Crenshaw _neither_ represents TX-2 nor America First Constitutionalism, that doesn't mean I don't appreciate his service as a Navy Seal, because I do very much so.
As a matter of fact, I tip my hat to all the veterans and service men and women who have served and given their lives to secure our liberty.
**That being said, let me address an elephant in the room:**
I know there's a lot of frustration amongst **informed voters** that are frustrated with **uninformed voters** that choose to support a candidate _simply_ because they served in the military.
But can we just cut through the politically correct B.S. for a moment and be **patriotically correct**?
Just because someone is a veteran doesn't necessarily mean they have any business serving in Congress, **nor do they get a free pass on voting for bad legislation**.
For those of you who may not know, there are a couple of videos circulating out there of **Alex Stein** \- **who is very frustrated with Dan Crenshaw's bad voting record and his ties to the World Economic Forum** \- where just in the last 24-48 hours can be seen confronting Crenshaw in a way that some might deem questionable and downright disrespectful.
That being said, would I have approached Crenshaw the way Alex Stein did?
No, because that's just not my style.
**But make no mistake about it...** I along with several others understand Alex Stein's frustration.
**It's frustrating** to see Dan Crenshaw complain about inflation and act as if he cares whenever he voted to pass a $1.5 Trillion Omnibus funding Biden's vaccine mandates right before voting to send $40 Billion to Ukraine.
**It's frustrating** to see someone who served as a Navy Seal be named a Young Global Leader by Klaus Schwab and the World Economic Forum back in 2019.
As a fifth-generation Texan, **it's frustrating** to have watched people like Dan Crenshaw remain silent in 2020 as bureaucrats and big government tyrants mandated masks, shut down businesses, and destroyed family incomes.
As an American, **it's frustrating** to _know_ that there were irregularities with the 2020 election that warrant a full investigation - especially _after_ the evidence presented in 2000 Mules - only to be represented by Dan Crenshaw who is on record stating that he believes Biden legitimately won.
**But know this:** America First Constitutionalism is alive and well and the 2024 primaries are right around the corner... so stay tuned.Feel free to email with any questions.

/// End statement

Team, September is the most important month for fundraising that we’ve faced so far. In just a few weeks, we’ll be in the most critical period of this race — when most voters will be tuning in and preparing to cast their ballots. **That’s why we need to make up ground after we fell just short of our mid-month fundraising goal yesterday.** The sky isn’t falling, and we’re not panicking. But here’s the truth: Our last quarterly FEC fundraising deadline is in just two weeks, and now we’re short of our goal. That means that we might have to scale back our digital ads, organizing operation, and TV budget — and National Republicans will see that our momentum is slowing down. Mitch McConnell has already spent _$250,000_ on TV ads to boost Michael’s opponent, and the National GOP has amassed a $331 million warchest to flip seats like Michael’s — so if we fall short, they could decide that Colorado is worth even more of their investment. **[Let’s prove them wrong, team. subject: South Carolina Freedom Caucus Fights Woke Madness
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Patriots,
Last week, the epicenter of the ongoing battle against the radical Left’s increasingly authoritarian woke agenda arrived in South Carolina. The University of South Carolina canceled a two-game women’s basketball series against Brigham Young University in the aftermath of allegations made by a Duke University volleyball player–and her radical activist godmother–that racial slurs were leveled against her during Duke’s match with BYU.

A thorough and subsequent investigation by both BYU officials and independent reporters verified what many suspected at the time the accusations were made: **the incident never happened**. Once again, another Jussie Smollet-inspired race hoax was fabricated to serve the progressive narrative and destructive lie that America is a systemically racist nation. And per usual, the _New York Times_ , ESPN, and other left-wing outlets ran with the narrative without verifying the actual facts.

Fortunately, the South Carolina Freedom Caucus is not allowing their state’s flagship university to get away with perpetuating the damnable lie that took hold in the partisan press. Instead, they chose to**fight back** and **stand up** **against the woke madness** devouring our institutions and seeking to destroy our civil society.

Members of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus [sent a letter](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=d14600bd1b&e=64ecec6d03) to women’s basketball coach Dawn Staley and athletic director Ray Tanner outlining the facts of the race hoax perpetrated by the activist godmother of the Duke University volleyball player at the center of the fake story. These warrior legislators have demanded the university comply with an official FOIA request on all records regarding the school’s decision to cancel the games against BYU and to uphold the “commitment to the deeply American tenets of the presumption of innocence and fairness.”

And now that the [investigation](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=0939f04399&e=64ecec6d03) into the alleged incident has proven that it never occurred ([even CNN is conceding it!!](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=0d2df898f9&e=64ecec6d03)), the South Carolina Freedom Caucus is demanding that their state university reschedule the games and issue an apology to BYU and the broader public for acting without regard for the truth.

This is **exactly how conservative lawmakers are supposed to fight** for their constituents and against the radical Left’s hateful and divisive obsession with Critical Race Theory. Indeed, if it weren’t for the **very existence of the South Carolina Freedom Caucus** , no South Carolina elected officials would be holding these institutions accountable for their submission to the woke mob.

Creating organized bands of conservative warriors in state legislatures is precisely what the State Freedom Caucus Network is doing. Since we officially launched last December, the Network is helping to create freedom caucuses in all 50 state capitols - modeled after the successful House Freedom Caucus. The Network is equipping liberty-minded state lawmakers with the resources, policy knowledge, and procedural strategies they need to ensure the rights of their citizens are protected and the progressive policies crushing American households and choking cherished institutions are dismantled.

**This work is vital and growing more important by the day.**

The battle for freedom will ultimately be won or lost in the states, not in the distant throes of the D.C. swamp.

**Will you consider helping our efforts and fighting alongside us? **

**For just $10 a month, you can support the State Freedom Caucus Network as it works to secure liberty at the state level and finally bring your voice to your state capitol. **

**Click[here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=47fc7384af&e=64ecec6d03) to set up your recurring monthly donation now. Even $25 or $50 will make a huge difference.**

Thanks to your help and your commitment to the ideas that have made America the indispensable nation, we believe we will organize champion legislators in every state capitol to unapologetically battle against the woke sickness plaguing our nation.
Keep fighting,

**Andy Roth
President, State Freedom Caucus Network**

P.S. Your help is critical in building out a network of patriots and freedom fighters throughout our nation’s state capitols and in your home state. Please consider a [contribution here](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=c995e2703d&e=64ecec6d03) and join us as together we work to advance the cause of liberty.

Friend --

With the midterms fast approaching, I want to call attention to some of the people who make our democracy work.

Poll workers play a crucial role in the administration of our elections -- helping voters cast their ballots, and making sure elections run smoothly. Without unbiased poll workers, our democracy doesn’t function.

Recently, however, poll workers have been the target of threats, intimidation, and harassment by people trying to undermine our elections and tilt the results in their favor. That’s why All On The Line has been working hard to find and mobilize poll workers for the midterm elections -- because we can’t let the bullies win.

Did you ever question the results of the 2020 election? Even in private?

Have you ever told anyone that you think our government has become too big or too powerful?

Did you happen to do any of that over Facebook? Even in a private message to someone?

If you did, then you were probably red flagged by Facebook and reported to the FBI!

No, this isn't a bad joke or hyperbole.

Sources within the Department of Justice recently went public with damning information against Facebook, who literally spied on their own users who questioned the legitimacy of the 2020 election, flagging them as "anti-government", and then reported the information to FBI field officers to follow up.

One source recently told the _New York Post_ , "It was done outside of the legal process and without probable cause . . . Facebook provides the FBI with private conversations, which are protected by the First Amendment without any subpoena."

Now, the FBI and U.S. Attorneys knew that what they were doing was illegal, because if a "lead" from Facebook required a follow-up, they would then request a subpoena to "officially" get the information.

This is a GROSS violation of our privacy, and it directly ties into my RICO lawsuit that I have filed against Facebook, Twitter, Mark Zuckerberg, and Jack Dorsey.

These Big Tech companies are criminal organizations, and it's our job to SHUT THEM DOWN!

We are predicted to have increasing tidal flooding that will damage our infrastructure. **** We need leaders that understand the risks of climate change and make investments to help. Leaders on the take from Big Oil are not the answer.

We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend. Friend -- Let's keep it real: Some days are great. Some aren't so great. Some days bring subpoenas and revelations and faith in accountability. Some days bring maddening setbacks and discouragement and fear for our democracy. I bet you feel it, too. It's the battle of faith over fear. But the thing that keeps me focused and dialed in is duty. Democracy cannot function without it, without us realizing our responsibility to serve and preserve it in ways big or small. And we don't just do it for us -- we do it for the next generation; for the kids who don't realize what we're all living through _isn't_ normal, that there _is_ a better way. And that's why I'm so thankful for the incredible work Country First is doing with young people across America. Through our **Next Generation Ambassadors** program, we are equipping students and chapters on more than 50 college campuses (and growing!). Indeed, the _next_ generation will either help to save us or help to destroy us -- and it's up to us to show them there's a better way to lead and govern during their formative years. Therefore, I hope you'll consider helping in at least one of the following ways: 1) Send [this link](https://www.country1st.com/next_generation?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_nd&n=2) to every college-age student you know who might be interested in getting involved, helping our country, AND adding something unique and valuable to his or her resume: [https://www.country1st.com/next_generation](https://www.country1st.com/next_generation?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_nd&n=3) | [](https://www.country1st.com/next_gen?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_nd&n=4 "SUPPORT OUR NEXT GENERATION") [SUPPORT OUR NEXT GENERATION](https://www.country1st.com/next_gen?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_nd&n=4)
---
2) [Donate](https://www.country1st.com/next_gen?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_nd&n=5) in support of our Next Generation initiative to ensure we can help spread this program to as many campuses as possible.
We can have the greatest impact on our nation's future by working with, mentoring, and influencing young people today. Thank you for all you do to make this program possible!
Country First,
Adam
PS: I've been meeting with the other members of the 1/6 Committee, and I'm excited for you to hear more about our Fall hearing schedule soon. Stay tuned!

I never saw myself ever writing an email like this one.

This is ret Navy SEAL Senior Chief, Derrick Van Orden. I'm President Trump's nominee in WI-03 - the most important race on the map. I've spent 26 years serving my country and facing America's worst enemies on the battlefield.

**If Pelosi beats me, she 'll destroy every Republican on the ballot. **

The Democrats have already spent over **$100 MILLION** bucks in ads to crush every conservative candidate like me, with another flood of attack spending on the way.

[**That 's why I'm personally asking for your help right now. If we see a groundswell of grassroots support, we'll have a chance to turn things around and finally stop Biden and Pelosi.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61301888:6lpP0hVNk:m:1:3331421248:B57E61D4A3F820FB3B8DE911F67E276F:r)

Look, I'm a Navy SEAL - I'm not one who normally asks for help, but things are hanging by a thread right now. **If we don 't pull this off, America is finished.**

This week, Peter’s op-ed _“Shame On You, Alum Rock School District”_ was featured **nationwide** on Townhall! As this editorial continues to gain traction, we invite you to take a peek & share the article link with your online community:
**Shame On You, Alum Rock School District**
Alum Rock School District, a working class, small-business-heavy district of East San Jose, California, is continuing to perpetuate what is at best the most ridiculous and at worst the cruelest part of the whole covid-mandates fiasco, which is masking children in school. Alum Rock School District is one of the last few holdouts NATIONWIDE to maintain this coercive tactic against the local families it is supposed to serve. Thankfully, a father of two sons, fourth and sixth graders, is suing the district because it is refusing instruction to his sons. Adelante Academy has disallowed his sons’ entry to the school because they decline to wear COVID masks. The father has let the school know that the masks irritate his sons’ faces and are a distraction to their learning. But the school has made no accommodations for the boys’ education. He has asked for homework assignments or class handouts so his sons can continue their education at home. The school has refused. As the basis for the suit, the father’s attorney cites, “The children of California have the right to in-person education free from harassment and discrimination and in this situation the district is violating those rights.” Darn straight they are. Shame on you, Alum Rock School District.**** Let’s take a look at the school officials’ decision in light of current public policy. The Center for Disease Control recently revised its COVID-related recommendations on vaccinations, physical separation, quarantining and masking. It is no longer the CDC recommendation that schools screen ‘apparently healthy’ students. The intention of the change in CDC guidance, according to the Washington Post, is to put “more of the onus on individuals, rather than on schools, businesses and other institutions, to limit viral spread.” Evidently, the Alum Rock school board believes it understands the balance between parental and school official health decisions for students better than the CDC. Evidently, the Alum Rock school board believes it can define a healthy learning environment better than the students’ parents... _**(Follow the link to continue reading...)**_

Fellow American, if you’ve been reading my emails for a while, then you probably already know that Texas’ 15th Congressional District was established in 1903 and has only ever elected Democrat candidates to represent it.

That’s right, **_this district has never had a REPUBLICAN representative it in its history._**

[**But we’re going to change that this year.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c2996df79c174c73aad5fc6a1504fc3b&_e=nLQsLFAqmvs4ogVScztP21A36sVn3Vyy0nZ6DsuE8w4ysKADwqQaSyRwyvhRWIugcjNhRM_ltSpaKkwpvRX1yMJ02yK6O-aCPNEIA2fwFGScXW6bfop2dVUrnt1ZOsvQuq025D2ROiXnNVbtGt1Z3B1NS7gBftQgOCAdTrg3H3SIbfZcjL5LrB-FKZzJF77H9xDMlB4DZpbPV9mdHnxGE-xpUO28YMbUToRQe5PbICLRc4i754msy2IXBDSU2cNo3Gml2qCVOKaFe8nPWNTI6JbAep3iD8fmXgAJsfQeGInwez-Cyug9yWVfTGJZyFOZ7ekGydgYIC9hcPvSjbTO7mFmnZ7pqJoEUzzA8eUUpcAgEMa299pbIcQsBxQk1OLFqbePVA9zLig9tHHW4cAPvrgHq2qRaGXH4EdFAreTzqI%3D)
As we get down to the final three months of this campaign, things are only going to get crazier, busier, and more expensive. I can tell you from experience, the Democrats are only getting started on their mission to hold on to this seat and keep the majority.

In the final few days of the 2020 election, the Democrats saw the writing in the walls and FLOODED resources to South Texas to help my Democrat challenger succeed. They had then vice-presidential nominee Kamala Harris along with Beto O'Rourke visit the district and had AOC on the phone bank making non-stop calls.
