subject: I feel like I can't get a break
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alek for Oregon
body:
They RNC keeps moving the ball on me. We've been given an other warning: if I am unable to raise $50,000 by the end of the month, no help is coming. Today I'm asking you to help me give back to the men and women of the national guard who are stepping up to protect our communities in this time of uncertainty. Don't want to receive our emails? [Unsubscribe here.](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_s=efaf4a8b8c3647e386142e31e581361e&_t=KpGV2oLm4YVNyF_Bz9KJYQPFTqKLizlRmYSxhZ0Z0yWMPiZyeLKtLzzTwewz5nIvorQPUcRGGcO5aILEuXkMfr0oSi5EsxcVj_1BFH4d-tU%3D) | [](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=efaf4a8b8c3647e386142e31e581361e&_e=ni5GJI-63Hz8Qdwng4YHpsB4aHXyZXnv49SJuyRjAFvr8V__eoLzx_M1rRdPAtdjAiLntkp9wSt6QocMeC3xnjgamY4y7YsGZnIz9koWt1w1DPHwFmwytj4GI1-92iJeUpF2sVHBXDCezVbJeb4A3FIM4zkeuWanmEFM4851gkPJ4-75xHHM_xOenzN13tp6q9ahT4MRFD3SN1sFstAH-Oo6R4KG9diMR1abyo5xmGGrV7W6uS3inyxrMQmrtlZto12Bwh6lhBh_NeD2htrzgzRzfW04lrdrhiecIKIGRzvT39Jnp8qNoMrUYcrMSYhb1keiUlsho9hld2ytVeRgR1KI5WaQG9GjbkMXMdWMKRQyIpKoGf168JBOCfa9ler4wd4cG88DJMn_XkXokMqwFQ%3D%3D)
---
Peter,

**If I’m not able to raise an additional $100,000 by September 30th, we risk the national Republican Party not sending support I need to win this race.** **
They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 14 days to go, we’re still short about $60,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=efaf4a8b8c3647e386142e31e581361e&_e=ni5GJI-63Hz8Qdwng4YHpsB4aHXyZXnv49SJuyRjAFvr8V__eoLzx_M1rRdPAtdjAiLntkp9wSt6QocMeC3xnjgamY4y7YsGZnIz9koWt1w1DPHwFmwytj4GI1-92iJeUpF2sVHBXDCezVbJeb4A3FIM4zkeuWanmEFM4851gkPJ4-75xHHM_xOenzN13tp6q9ahT4MRFD3SN1sFstAH-Oo6R4KG9diMR1abyo5xmGGrV7W6uS3inyxrMQmrtlZt1-MRBAJsj8BNj6rjbuXxsQQNaZUR_NuXI0yqZmYZMOq5a3QnIzfk2gn8WMeaJP6rgG5GrPqriWeHFkU2xxDo0n4nheNduenl91aF8xD-FbA88vJ0YZacSo4fRVCE6q10VJxEOSpA0bpj7PzyFCXYjg%3D%3D)**

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=efaf4a8b8c3647e386142e31e581361e&_e=ni5GJI-63Hz8Qdwng4YHpsB4aHXyZXnv49SJuyRjAFvr8V__eoLzx_M1rRdPAtdjAiLntkp9wSt6QocMeC3xnjgamY4y7YsGZnIz9koWt1w1DPHwFmwytj4GI1-92iJeUpF2sVHBXDCezVbJeb4A3FIM4zkeuWanmEFM4851gkPJ4-75xHHM_xOenzN13tp6q9ahT4MRFD3SN1sFstAH-Oo6R4KG9diMR1abyo5xmGGrV7W6uS3inyxrMQmrtlZtkubtOdlBOjOwQIB4I73M1JQUeS3XSBCX3aUjs7VHle-WqC3kGYq_kriUe4BlCNyqGhMkH2Pr6J0mZW72SS1QkiNx_I30dFvtoI22T9O8AcmjLZ4iLPvb1u_xpD4E6Jn7NePpm2xdCjZ5zMVygxTaSg%3D%3D)
---

Whether it’s a test or not - I’m not taking any chances. While Oregon’s 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, **it’s ripe for the picking now that he is _finally _retiring__**.

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=efaf4a8b8c3647e386142e31e581361e&_e=ni5GJI-63Hz8Qdwng4YHpsB4aHXyZXnv49SJuyRjAFvr8V__eoLzx_M1rRdPAtdjAiLntkp9wSt6QocMeC3xnjgamY4y7YsGZnIz9koWt1w1DPHwFmwytj4GI1-92iJeUpF2sVHBXDCezVbJeb4A3FIM4zkeuWanmEFM4851gkPJ4-75xHHM_xOenzN13tp6q9ahT4MRFD3SN1sFstAH-Oo6R4KG9diMR1abyo5xmGGrV7W6uS3inyxrMQmrtlZtTT0c93PV7i-rM31rAkjbEc-Xi8TC_-lJtzXtOgsE1iLmHaZUBNo0ZJ6OVNqSWd7Q8DnZKltGMQ6kHS4yxQU9lMtQGQY5qhMcx7IoQ0QXK1qkXX93w3sfLRonLZ-ohRU9NchiI0cqjX_K6PKbEnisaw%3D%3D)**

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=efaf4a8b8c3647e386142e31e581361e&_e=ni5GJI-63Hz8Qdwng4YHpsB4aHXyZXnv49SJuyRjAFvr8V__eoLzx_M1rRdPAtdjAiLntkp9wSt6QocMeC3xnjgamY4y7YsGZnIz9koWt1w1DPHwFmwytj4GI1-92iJeUpF2sVHBXDCezVbJeb4A3FIM4zkeuWanmEFM4851gkPJ4-75xHHM_xOenzN13tp6q9ahT4MRFD3SN1sFstAH-Oo6R4KG9diMR1abyo5xmGGrV7W6uS3inyxrMQmrtlZthsBCRdKV-9dCcIbY2O_VKkwADGgYOTRdGxYQltBI35kIRYTyBMZCk2w-hBjje-AgoP-0WbYwNpdBAitWXsplF_Dhz3dmFNhaKcim43-_kM850MSp-AadCg6cfJmIoDlm2nHYazx9Q71AkaHzQ6wRMg%3D%3D)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I’d like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker’s gavel next Congress? **Less than 10**.

19 miles to go, friend. We're in the final stretch.
As I'm writing you this email, I've been traveling from one rally to the next and just got back on the campaign bus. With only 53 days left before Election Day, I'm visiting every single corner of Florida – from the Panhandle to the Keys.

And, in the background of all of this, I hear my mother's voice in my head telling me, "Never tire of doing good, Val."
That's what energizes me as I travel to all 67 counties of Florida to surge ahead in this race. I know winning this race will make a meaningful difference for Florida – and for our country – but polls show me neck and neck with Marco Rubio right now.
That's why I'm asking for your support in the final stretch of my campaign. Unlike Marco Rubio, my average donation is just $29.04, so I rely on people like you to help me fund voter outreach and move forward in these final few weeks.

I'm about to hop off the bus at my next campaign event, so I have to ask: If you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you donate $5 today? As a proud Latina woman, I couldn’t be more excited to celebrate, honor, and uplift the Hispanic and Latino community.
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50809422/367262208/-1401211300?refcode=em_msg_2022.09.16_b1_at_all-nd&refcode2=2d1a19d8-d435-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZDFhMTlkOC1kNDM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O4hoEmtAYe-2YyTGfTi4cx4NW4Jl_usZ4SDOnVnRFz8=)**
Friend,

**Happy Hispanic Heritage Month!** Every September and October, Hispanic Heritage Month offers us a moment to reflect on the contributions that Hispanic and Latino people make to our country.

And as a proud Latina woman, I couldn’t be more excited to celebrate, honor, and uplift the Hispanic and Latino community.

**One of my favorite parts of Hispanic Heritage Month is listening to the millions of stories – each unique and different – told by people within our community.** For me, my family immigrated to this country in search of freedom. We fled an unstable Colombia when my father was kidnapped by a Marxist terrorist group, and started a new life here in the United States when I was seventeen years old. And a few decades later, I went on to become the first Latina Democrat ever elected to the Florida State Senate.

But, friend, my story is one of millions.

Every day, I feel immense pride for my family, my story, and my heritage. So today and every day, I hope you’ll join me in uplifting the voices and stories of those within the Hispanic and Latino community. Happy Hispanic Heritage Month!

Gracias,

Annette

_P.S. It is so important to me that I use my position as a public servant to advocate for the needs of my community. In Congress, I will never fail to fight for the advancement of South Florida’s Hispanic and Latino people. extreme voter suppression law that makes it easier for a single person to
challenge legal voters.

challenge thousands of voters in counties with large brown, Black and
Democratic populations across Georgia. Just look:

boxes Monday containing what its leader says are 37,500 challenges to voters in

body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220916?refcode=lpfe220916_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220916?refcode=lpfe220916_m]

This week, you have probably already seen the news that Senator Lindsey Graham has introduced federal legislation to ban abortion after 15 weeks nationwide.
After all the years of hearing from Republican politicians and activists claim that abortion was an issue that should be decided by the states, the rush to embrace a nationwide ban on abortion shows us what they have really sought to do all along.
Extreme lawmakers have made it clear they won’t let up their efforts to take away our rights to make our own decisions about our bodies, our families, and our futures. The consequences are devastating and we’ve seen them firsthand in Texas, which has become ground zero for attacks on reproductive freedom.
In Congress, I’m working to protect our right to reproductive care and our ability to access it. But if we lose our majorities in the House and the Senate, the ability of the Congress to protect reproductive rights will come to a halt. Senator Graham’s bill is one of many bills that Republicans in Congress have already introduced to roll back reproductive rights.
Earlier this summer, only eight House Republicans voted to protect the right to use birth control!
There are many things we can do right now, and that includes getting voters to the polls to vote for pro-choice candidates up and down the ballot in November. Everywhere.
I’m working every day to do this, and I hope I can count on your help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220916?refcode=lpfe220916_m]
I truly believe we can hold the House, pick up seats in the Senate, and protect our rights and freedoms in the next Congress as long as we do everything we can to win today.
Together, we can do anything.

I want to make one thing clear: This isn’t about politics. This is a REAL situation that happened and could happen at any moment due to the CLIMBING crime rates here in New Mexico. And to top it all off, I woke up to the news this morning that CNN has an article LYING about me and attacking our campaign. I’ve spent my career electing Democrats and winning tough elections.
#
Hi Derek, it’s Paul Begala.
I’ve spent my career electing Democrats and winning tough elections. In 1991, my buddy James Carville and I were on the ground in Pennsylvania and helped to elect its first Democratic senator since 1969.
So trust me when I say this: **I know John Fetterman has what it takes to flip Pennsylvania blue this November.**
His record-breaking grassroots campaign has put this race in the national spotlight and now, national Republicans are spending millions and trying every attack in the book in an effort to defeat John and keep this seat under their thumb. Our only choice is to fight back.

| | I see a future for Central Washington when others do not. I see our water projects finished, immigration reform enacted, wages rising, community centers thriving and our energy needs being met. Some call this pie in the sky, but I call it good math.You see, there is money to do all these things, it is our money! What we have been told is that any money spent on us or our district is wasteful and is going to raise the deficit and destroy our economy. What they don’t tell you is that our government officials can redirect money to different priorities without raising taxes or the deficit, they just don’t think we are a priority.What do they support instead of us? They supported increasing our deficit by eight trillion dollars during the last administration with nothing coming to us. They back policies that lost us precious foreign markets and our economy billions of dollars. They backed reducing the corporate tax rate from 35% to 21% thereby slashing our federal tax revenue by over a trillion dollars and passing the burden to us!There is enough of our tax dollars to defend this country and invest in ourselves. We need someone with the right set of priorities.

| | It was another busy week! I went from Omak for the Okanogan County Fair across to Nespelem for an interview. Stopped for a radio show then headed south to Bingen for the annual Huckleberry Festival and parade. Then I went to Pasco on Saturday for the Fiery Food Festival. The last stop was in Tieton Farm and Creamery where I had such a great time discussing the issue of fresh-water shortage and sharing my vision on how to support our community the most on farming and infrastructure.In between and around all of that I was talking to people all up and down this district along with city councils and just examining everything myself. This is a beautiful area with so much to give. We should not trust it to those that don't respect it. Those that refuse to protect us from drought, refuse land management to stop the wildfires, and deny our changing climate while our farmers suffer crop loss. I am ready to make a change. I hope I have your vote.

subject: here's the truth

body:
---
| | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| Friends and fellow patriots,
I don't like being lied about. Yes, I know, it comes with the territory in politics. And as a result, most politicians ignore the lies and rumors, in the hopes they will go away on their own. It's part of the game, so I'm told.
Well, as you know, I don't accept that. I want our politics to be better. I think we should demand honesty and integrity and decency. And so I have made a habit of debunking the lies of the left, AND the lies of the right.
As you can imagine, that makes some people very, very angry. Sensational lies and rumors, especially about your own side, get clicks and engagement. The people spreading those lies make money off of this game, and the last thing they want is for someone like me to fight back.
But that's exactly what I do. At the end of this email you will see an excellent tweet thread from a supporter of mine who was sick of the lies and thoroughly debunked every crazy rumor that has been spread about me by our own side. But I first want to explain to you why I think it is so important to share this set of facts in the first place. I want to explain the nature of the people who spread them, and who they really are.
I call them the Woke Right.
These are people who wear the red jersey and say the right things, but in reality are not tethered to conservative principles. They want you to believe that "right-wing" and "conservative" are the same thing, but they are not. They know nothing about conservative philosophy and do nothing to further the conservative cause. Persuading those who disagree with us is not their goal; gaining your attention for clicks is. They have never read a book by Thomas Sowell or Ben Shapiro or Russell Kirk. They don't know who William F. Buckley was, and in fact they are closer to Bernie Bros than Buckley.
They gain attention by screaming "RINO!" at the top of their lungs, a word that has been rendered meaningless at this point, a sloppy epithet designed to bypass serious discussion or debate. They would attack and smear Ronald Reagan if he were alive today, and would certainly not have supported his hard stand against the Soviets.
Their North Star isn't conservatism or western principles, but rather rank contrarianism, driven by hatred of whatever they view as mainstream conservative thought. They are self-labeled "outsiders" even though they have usually spent their entire career in political media or trying to break through on political twitter. The Woke Right has become a refugee camp for disaffected Q Anon conspiracy theorists who believe 9/11 was an inside job, and Alt-Right provocateurs who despise our support for Israel and label anyone who disagrees a "globalist!".
They differ from the far left only in the color of the jersey they wear. The list of similarities is staggering:

* Both the far left and Woke Right want to tear down republican institutions if it means the smallest win for their side.
* Resentment is their primary motivator, and they are quick to feign victimhood over the smallest offense if it means more money in their pockets or more clout online.
* They believe all American foreign policy is a net negative for us and the world, and as a result they also despise the veterans who fought for our country.
* Both believe in total government takeover of tech and institutions if it suits their short term goals, but are quick to call for the defunding of law enforcement in the same breath.
* They are *obsessed* with petty tribalism, as if politics were not about ideological differences (it should be) but rather superficial high school cliques with ever-changing loyalty tests and idiosyncratic rituals and slogans.
* Winning is not their goal. Winning means the responsibility of governing and problem solving, which is the last thing they want. They thrive off conflict, not solutions.
* And both are driven by hatred, not inspiration nor higher ideals.

You may not have noticed these tactics or attributes before. Most good conservatives haven't, instead assuming that the influencers or politicians or media personalities they follow are all on the same team. You may be scratching your head, wondering who I am talking about specifically. I won't name names here (because thats exactly what many of them want. The attention), but instead hope that you will now have the tools to identify this type of so-called conservative and call them out as the Woke Right they really are.
I'm one of the few (maybe only) politicians that fights this toxic infiltration of our party, which has focused its fire on me for that very reason: I fight back. I do that because you support me and I feel it is my responsibility to lead our conservative movement back to the Reagan Revolution that inspired a generation and defeated communism.
I believe I need to give you the ammunition you need to do the same. We are all sick of the shameless and blatant lies, and many of you have asked me where they can find the truth so that you can help me push back.
That is why one of my supporters felt the need to put the below fact thread together. Please have a read and share it far and wide, and please continue to support my mission if you are able to. As I've said in the past, when you donate to my campaign your money does not sit and collect dust. Your money is put to immediate use growing our conservative movement so we can win and provide a better future for our country based on the principles of our Founding.
You can support my campaign by mailing a donation to Crenshaw for Congress, P.O. Box 430965, Houston, TX 77243 or donating online here:

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | Friends and fellow patriots, I don't like being lied about. Yes, I know, it comes with the territory in politics. And as a result, most politicians ignore the lies and rumors, in the hopes they will go away on their own. It's part of the game, so I'm told. Well, as you know, I don't accept that. I want our politics to be better. I think we should demand honesty and integrity and decency. And so I have made a habit of debunking the lies of the left, AND the lies of the right. As you can imagine, that makes some people very, very angry. Sensational lies and rumors, especially about your own side, get clicks and engagement. The people spreading those lies make money off of this game, and the last thing they want is for someone like me to fight back. But that's exactly what I do. At the end of this email you will see an excellent tweet thread from a supporter of mine who was sick of the lies and thoroughly debunked every crazy rumor that has been spread about me by our own side. But I first want to explain to you why I think it is so important to share this set of facts in the first place. I want to explain the nature of the people who spread them, and who they really are. I call them the Woke Right. These are people who wear the red jersey and say the right things, but in reality are not tethered to conservative principles. They want you to believe that "right-wing" and "conservative" are the same thing, but they are not. They know nothing about conservative philosophy and do nothing to further the conservative cause. Persuading those who disagree with us is not their goal; gaining your attention for clicks is. They have never read a book by Thomas Sowell or Ben Shapiro or Russell Kirk. They don't know who William F. Buckley was, and in fact they are closer to Bernie Bros than Buckley. They gain attention by screaming "RINO!" at the top of their lungs, a word that has been rendered meaningless at this point, a sloppy epithet designed to bypass serious discussion or debate. They would attack and smear Ronald Reagan if he were alive today, and would certainly not have supported his hard stand against the Soviets. Their North Star isn't conservatism or western principles, but rather rank contrarianism, driven by hatred of whatever they view as mainstream conservative thought. They are self-labeled "outsiders" even though they have usually spent their entire career in political media or trying to break through on political twitter. The Woke Right has become a refugee camp for disaffected Q Anon conspiracy theorists who believe 9/11 was an inside job, and Alt-Right provocateurs who despise our support for Israel and label anyone who disagrees a "globalist!". They differ from the far left only in the color of the jersey they wear. The list of similarities is staggering: Both the far left and Woke Right want to tear down republican institutions if it means the smallest win for their side. Resentment is their primary motivator, and they are quick to feign victimhood over the smallest offense if it means more money in their pockets or more clout online. They believe all American foreign policy is a net negative for us and the world, and as a result they also despise the veterans who fought for our country. Both believe in total government takeover of tech and institutions if it suits their short term goals, but are quick to call for the defunding of law enforcement in the same breath. They are obsessed with petty tribalism, as if politics were not about ideological differences (it should be) but rather superficial high school cliques with ever-changing loyalty tests and idiosyncratic rituals and slogans. Winning is not their goal. Winning means the responsibility of governing and problem solving, which is the last thing they want. They thrive off conflict, not solutions. * And both are driven by hatred, not inspiration nor higher ideals. You may not have noticed these tactics or attributes before. Most good conservatives haven't, instead assuming that the influencers or politicians or media personalities they follow are all on the same team. You may be scratching your head, wondering who I am talking about specifically. I won't name names here (because thats exactly what many of them want. The attention), but instead hope that you will now have the tools to identify this type of so-called conservative and call them out as the Woke Right they really are. I'm one of the few (maybe only) politicians that fights this toxic infiltration of our party, which has focused its fire on me for that very reason: I fight back. I do that because you support me and I feel it is my responsibility to lead our conservative movement back to the Reagan Revolution that inspired a generation and defeated communism. I believe I need to give you the ammunition you need to do the same. We are all sick of the shameless and blatant lies, and many of you have asked me where they can find the truth so that you can help me push back. That is why one of my supporters felt the need to put the below fact thread together. Please have a read and share it far and wide, and please continue to support my mission if you are able to. As I've said in the past, when you donate to my campaign your money does not sit and collect dust. Your money is put to immediate use growing our conservative movement so we can win and provide a better future for our country based on the principles of our Founding. subject: [VOTER PRO TIP ALERT] Early Voting Starts September 23
body:
Early Voting Starts September 23 | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/46cbc3894276/voter-pro-tip-alert-early-voting-starts-september-23?e=0ba866af2d)
---
|
---
|
---
Peter, this might not be the pro tip you were looking for, but it is the pro tip you need to steer clear of the hassles on election day.
1. **Maximize your convenience - starting September 23rd, you can vote early.** Don’t risk something blocking you from voting on election day. You can request an absentee ballot online for federal, state, and county elections.
1. It can be done by mail, in person, or in the military abroad
2. You can also [track your absentee ballot here](https://gmail.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=fcce478b01&e=0ba866af2d)
2. Are you registered to vote? [Check it here](https://gmail.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=0666c602b4&e=0ba866af2d)
3. [Here’s how to register to vote](https://gmail.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=861b960ce6&e=0ba866af2d)
4. [Here’s how to find where to vote](https://gmail.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=bbab5f14f8&e=0ba866af2d)

**Campaign Progress Check-in** My campaign’s success can be witnessed in the multitude of yard signs throughout Beltrami County because people are ready for someone to stand up for our community and its issues. They are tired of inaction and gridlock. Besides being a small business owner in Bemidji and County Commissioner, **I build coalitions and mend divisions**.I saw a need in our community to reduce the number of deaths from weather’s impact on those experiencing homelessness. So, I helped form a coalition that built a 26-bed emergency shelter in Bemidji. Then, when I saw that the libraries were under threat of losing funding, I led a campaign to educate our community members about the essential services that our libraries provide and how the proposed cuts would affect us all. My leadership inspired robust letter writing and lively in-person protests from library staff, patrons, and other constituents. My advocacy for public libraries spans years in office and I heartily supported the library’s unionization.**So much more can be done when I’m elected as your representative of District 2A.**[**Now, help us meet our fundraising deadline this month!**](https://gmail.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f55dc7af213002cce7e62bd8&id=51235c5f34&e=0ba866af2d) If we reach that goal, we can buy digital ads to spread the positive Northwoods values. We need to change the conversation about our district. Even if we ignore our representative’s embarrassing behavior like his supporters are willing to do, we can’t ignore the fact that he has done nothing in St. Paul to address the multiple crises facing our community: affordable housing, childcare availability, and mental health. This should be the conversation.

| Peter,
My team and I have told you that this race here in Nevada would be one of the most closely-watched in the entire country...
And now, it's coming down to the wire.

clean_body: ...whether you want to or not. | | | | | Friend — This week, Tom Malinowski and all of his friends were invited to the White House for a party to celebrate the signing of Joe Biden’s “Inflation Reduction Act”. Although we weren’t invited to the big shindig, we all received party favors... Despite the nice name of their reckless spending bill,inflation just clocked in at a crushing 8.3%, and a jaw-dropping $1.6 TRILLION was wiped out as the stock market crashed. While Biden and Malinowski are living it up in their own little pretend world, the reality of their party is crashing down on the rest of us: Basic living expenses are pricier, and our 401(k) and life savings continue to disintegrate. Parties are fun and it feels good to vote for bills with nice names, but we need a representative in Congress, like TOM KEAN, JR, who will actually get to work to turn our economy around instead of partying it up with his friends. Tom Kean, Jr. might not get invited to any of Biden’s ironically named parties, but he’d be too busy working to fix our economy to attend anyway. ##
16 September 22

There is 1 week left until mail-in ballots are sent out (Sep 24) and 5 weeks until early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!
**Final Donations**
The election is coming up soon! Please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us secure our commitments for print ads, radio ads and texting which all need to be purchased in advance. Your donation will help us secure our media commitments.
Consider, $100, buys:
* 1 Radio Ad
* 5 Large Signs
* 20,000 texts

How many can you help us purchase?
**Sign Waving**
This Saturday, September 17
Noon-1p
The intersection of Old Branch Ave and Kirby Rd.
Park at Dash In
7505 Old Branch Ave, Clinton, 20735
FREE JW4C T-shirt provided for those who have not yet received one.
Be sure to bring your water bottle.

**Yard Signs**
We want to begin having yard signs pop-up throughout the District especially for those who live on or near busy roadways.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 7 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=33721f73e2&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

body:
Local Law Enforcement Continue to Rally Behind Chabot’s Campaign Against Extreme Candidate Candidate Who Wrote Proposal to Defund the Police| | |

**Warren County Fraternal Order of Police Endorse Congressman Chabot for Reelection** _Local Law Enforcement Continue to Rally Behind Chabot’s Campaign Against Extreme Candidate Candidate Who Wrote Proposal to Defund the Police_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John Gomez Email: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released the following statement on receiving a unanimous endorsement for reelection from the Warren County Fraternal Order of Police on Wednesday.

“I’m incredibly humbled to have the endorsement and support of the men and women who serve to keep Warren County communities safe.” Congressman Steve Chabot said. “I’m proud of my record of delivering results for our first responders and police, supporting safer communities and fighting back against extreme voices who try to vilify law enforcement.”

“I’m thankful to the Warren County Fraternal Order of Police and the Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police for supporting my campaign for reelection,” Chabot continued. “I look forward to continuing to stand with law enforcement and ensure they have the support, training, equipment and respect they need to keep southwest Ohio families safe.”

“My campaign’s growing support from the law enforcement community highlights the contrast between my record and that of my opponent,” Chabot said. “While I’ve always supported those who serve to keep us safe, Greg Landsman sided with the most radical elements of his party by voting to strip a million dollars from law enforcement and introducing a plan to defund the Cincinnati police — even as Cincinnati faced rising crime and more murders. Ohio families simply cannot trust Landsman to keep our communities safe.” Read the Chabot campaign’s release on receiving the endorsement of the Cincinnati Fraternal Order of Police [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=71e0c3c7b0144af39a05540686dac53a&_e=ADbIDm7bkDK7AFOy7oHGS9iKvMCHSA1UrY5uuXPDXJLd3Y-NPVVgHzOCtBdmYaUFpuXyXt1m5XzkAYPOMCRtZacUj16EIVaAaHYDkM48ARY59WHhifBlC3U-KnKp4i0r3pQRQUE3Mi15Jxtw1W89fK5A6wzJ3WB2ABZt-hMFxPXT7lcfEIRSKDfBasdF9OIrjbcCn9GpJy-Y3z4hvKhFjIuNcia9Dco12c_bMR11k038DWfjYCaCIRrvyumBd_tRfK_VCOFbqPnOpNinDDwYpcWH5R008LYg6xuSz-62LSc%3D).

Learn more about Greg Landsman’s plan to defund the police [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=71e0c3c7b0144af39a05540686dac53a&_e=ADbIDm7bkDK7AFOy7oHGSzgkpEPx-e0Y5Dgc70vF-00pNwCUt9znXRtVwBUwulIURNDfk-YSQYqTPAvSihJJ4P6SF-G-MLpnqXVPLX83LfR_JDTWpfUNsB3pE8kVFYVkezrD0DxCS-adf7kbO4xUi8-ekkv03WjfjVyhgRR6lmFOVcHkYhJ2q__MhLL8PS8TK5E3Gyl5DwThPFgCB4gVPnLkqfEHsR1FdbxyqsLk6p9xaZaGqEprz_HiJ-5Ei1bhutLXg3xdBvjIbChhc9C7_z5_-YmLx9p11J7vz_ce7OOlkunDqZH121fiPXchiS-BlqKi9itA_R-frw4K5WZaIA%3D%3D).

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this isn’t
the email we had hoped to send you today.

We just barely missed our $10,000 mid-month fundraising goal. But, the
good news is that if one in three folks who read this email today each
chip in $3 then we can make up for this shortfall.

Look, we don’t have tens of millions of dollars in the bank like the
Democratic establishment. We reject all corporate PAC contributions
because we know that movements should be funded by people chipping in what
they can afford without any influence from corporations.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114313?refcode=em20220916-25160&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=25160%2E1203867%2ESNChc6 ]Will you be one of the folks who we need to make a contribution before
midnight to catch up on our fundraising?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114313?refcode=em20220916-25160&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=25160%2E1203867%2ESNChc6 ]Contribute

Even if we miss a fundraising goal we’ll never try to scare you into
donating. We’re not going to send you any terrifying, DCCC-style “the sky
is falling” emails. There is no reason to kiss all hope goodbye. And we
don’t have any generous donors to QUADRUPLE MATCH your donation.

But, we will politely ask you to contribute if you can afford it, so we
can keep our work going and keep providing critical organizing help and
other campaign services to our Justice Democrats running for office.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114313?refcode=em20220916-25160&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=25160%2E1203867%2ESNChc6 ]Please contribute today. Every single contribution will make a
difference in helping us reach our fundraising goal before the end of the
month.

Thank you for your solidarity,

Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=25160%2E1203867%2ESNChc6 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1024&akid=25160%2E1203867%2ESNChc6 ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4q2avairbqr3c9jv4lt173ura13m1c0e4qmngdo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65stjm2r66dtncdjmecri6do66ptk6iqe6dtkcdg61ohic2or2c30ehibcotm6lo6fkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup76phge2qr8c3i6pj38o5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6pj6cdimaor0c8iv0)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than sixty days until the Election and we're falling behind our Mid-Month Goal.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.**

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvdsphodccpv4pogrtd4ktkm1idkjm01uslbgcp8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ziuo0mgjnpdsared0eu0ismvuul6h9s0tsvvehh8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpdd4h6qq4dda8snvjv8lgheu6jgvbc82ng5p2f0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zn914efmsrlln6a3smr3gt46gp0k0dp9atvn0bvo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "4")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1a9uujoj2mu6a5vf44ui0srjsft3h73toa2fs9g_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.
** **[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1jithhc3du7obrti7hm5uqv6i7rpkva1co9v5rg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqmnldgbrje926jo09dbfe50069rgegcobqtsm1o_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |

* * *
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpnrutct1obqven6prm370vrmvrrv3ihprpf5ti8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "POLLS TIED!") I'm not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 100 days until the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls.

I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. Far-Left progressive groups are pouring in millions of dollars to try to win this Senate seat. The truth is, **I will lose if I don 't have your support.**

Please, Friend, I'm begging: **[Will you chip in right now?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt2kqlsck64kki46174nmctv5p1n7tj72e8q3gbo_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "Will you chip in right now?")** | | [SEND IMMEDIATE HELP](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdha89r41i1pt1v999bgn8fartg99b898jhfsv38_rp22sh2s8i66or6cphmapb3c1h2bs "SEND IMMEDIATE HELP")

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220916&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220916&amount=28]
Team,
With Election Day somehow only a few short weeks away, I wanted to give you a bit of a behind-the-scenes look at a critical part of our campaign: Michigan State University.
This is the first election where MSU students will be on campus and able to register to vote at their campus addresses – which means we’re currently in an all-out push to talk to as many students as we can, register them to vote, answer any questions they might have, and provide whatever resources they need.
A key piece of this is that we don’t just want to be talking at the students – we want them involved. Which is why we’ve hired part-time student organizers to help us spread the message to their peers. We’ve even been hosting “dorm storms” where our organizers hand out information to students in their dorms.
And because I’m a numbers nerd... let me break down the math for you. Each of our organizers make $22 an hour. We ask them to bring 3 friends who are student canvassers and make $18 an hour. Each shift typically lasts 2 hours. All together, each shift costs us about $150.
The strategy here is a bit different than the rest of the new district for a few reasons, namely – students just don’t watch traditional TV in the same way their parents do, therefore they’re much less likely to see any of my television ads. Which is why we’re taking this more effective (not to mention MUCH cheaper) approach.
If you would like to help out, consider a contribution of $18 to fund a student canvasser, $22 to fund a student organizer, or (if you’re feeling especially generous) $150 to fund an entire shift. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220916&amount=28] I, and some very eager college students, would be grateful!

Elissa

name: The Giffords Team
subject: This past week, we were on the road in Florida
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
We wanted to give you a look at some photos from our Florida bus tour:
#

Team -
This past week, Giffords Florida was proud to conduct a bus tour throughout the Sunshine State, making stops in Miami, St. Petersburg, Tampa, West Palm Beach, Hollywood, Ft. Lauderdale, Coral Springs, and Orlando.
_Our tour bus!_
On our tour, we were proud to have held events with so many Giffords-endorsed gun safety champions, such as Reps. Val Demings and Charlie Crist.
_Cheering on Rep. Val Demings in Miami as she wins her first dominos game in Little Havana!_
We hosted meet and greets and press conferences across the state with activists, survivors, and elected officials to discuss the importance of commonsense gun safety legislation, such as universal background checks.
We also discussed Giffords Law Center’s new memo, which highlights the disproportionate impact gun violence has on our Hispanic communities.
_Gabby Giffords sharing a smile with Congresswoman Debbie Wasserman Schultz at a meet and greet at Florida International University._
Of course, we couldn’t have a bus tour without canvassing for our gun safety champions on the ballot in Florida this November.
_Giffords Senior Advisor Debbie Mucarsell-Powell with volunteers at a canvassing event for Reps. Charlie Crist and Val Demings in Hollywood._
On the last day of the tour, Gabby and former Congresswoman and Giffords Senior Advisor Debbie Mucarsel-Powell visited the Pulse Nightclub memorial in Orlando. They remembered the lives we lost on June 12, 2016, and left with a renewed sense of why we continue in the fight to end gun violence.
_Gabby Giffords and Debbie Mucarsel-Powell sharing a hug at the Pulse Nightclub memorial._
We’re so glad we had the opportunity to meet Floridians this past week and speak with them about the importance of gun safety this critical election year. One thing is clear: Florida is filled with voters who are fired up and ready to vote for gun safety champions.
\- The team at Giffords
Thank you for supporting Giffords. We couldn’t make events like our Florida bus tour possible without your support. If you’d like to make a contribution to support more projects like this in the future, [**please use this link.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sept22.KOv07R&refcode=em220916-1-15&t=1&akid=2481%2E3935704%2Eksnt-8)

We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=3&akid=2481%2E3935704%2Eksnt-8) if you'd like to unsubscribe. | | **Bringing The Southern Border North 🧱**
---
| |
---
This week Kamala Harris had the audacity to say the "[border is secure](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=28bacb2338104a259d5a57590206349b&_e=Mm1k-O4-fgwGHiHTc3eSERQZ7eq-8YSzGVerJxXm8umSpGHd0_xlYpvsxnXpmsXoMO_glCjVgKTTqQZgMhJbBN59mK1aU8B_zR9r-VD2j6dP5TBS9iDyyE6QC0-7WxSnSKDGLIRwiDit_GmVlodpxMV8BFcw_xGWVzRyQmd7vsQvpJ8Vd_Xgtyqk4e9-yUeXEV-6uwf-vwMtMj23P91zvz4iTb0m0xgOTJqzvlp0tHRGD5QyZIEPoKlJN2B09FJWAYd-I2Z5WvZgi8dmkze4SDhLTd50cnZE95quLmuM2GQfn9iVNJD19ohGbos4OHWT)." And while this claim is the height of denial, what can we expect when she's never actually [seen](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=28bacb2338104a259d5a57590206349b&_e=Mm1k-O4-fgwGHiHTc3eSEQNRt6EOmqp_topqlqWJqJ4rnKfrXDVWdQGx6tfxAj9pKG__e40wu1wxlvhFs9rlY9RAUoz27OFVNmmXF36B_6zeZELGmsZEkXhtCQaVu1KdCPXXmF4_g00mK1DoBot6E2bquXfT8bQZu0SQIUl445NX7ElbgnNkUBYf9QJUMfJGs4xwGgc7aCcoJPgvaxGNPY0_d4QwV5Eho8P2_2tiNwRwcUmFSAtJvHnTnVPrAlljVdfM1jOTXKnqnTSoRJ3moSV95LqWyIYrt_bg8feIRNOo_jfwE1Z4tdqfquCpbWgt) the humanitarian crisis with her own eyes? From the very beginning of Joe Biden's presidency, he has courted a border catastrophe by rejecting President Trump's successful border security policies and sending a welcoming message to illegal immigrants the world over. Now, nearly two years into his administration, the catastrophe has only gotten worse. Almost [two million](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=28bacb2338104a259d5a57590206349b&_e=Mm1k-O4-fgwGHiHTc3eSEcTrvEbfUak_Um9jRRSaHLEq5uoiBCuVll0DSjvpEzl5HePX2L0163JXW-1TIapjkyo0eEqvOpIVvFvaBrNje00aQmdaLu1-kMbgkbH4eGKJQ_6wXV9LrEdyD_9n6tUKW5Q90Gx4eXAY0nTuF4jSTSCw0yyNbeGBS1J0JXLfZMEcMWBVt5ewYz4cc381KwBtBodykEVvbnUxSCLo7awnvJeKCYyAUbqG6_TiI_Fviaog) illegal immigrants have been apprehended this year alone—surpassing all of last year's figures. That number includes [81 individuals](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=28bacb2338104a259d5a57590206349b&_e=Mm1k-O4-fgwGHiHTc3eSEQq_r1kbHK6uCTQxKfS3wu8yrK0PsR2x6pVgw7ag9WOwsRF20zf_yAZAKUsCheHidEVvjgBu7rE6zxP5TkpJW6YarukMB8v_g-7FwKcnylZRC8lQO9b8OKJ695sQMZEQFMY38ynIIfLvKjjXUVP8evGH7uldMyJ2SmBIYZsNNfIiQrEyOk5SvdzeklO86ycY1W0kmfx00Ghw3NBPBlAnqV61OZnUxjWgr-CFiWCGjmcQh-6cRzciB1D5nIK5AeCJ4IPpYtnof0E2zvELjSHZEWs%3D) on the U.S. terrorist watchlist and a whopping [10,600 pounds](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=28bacb2338104a259d5a57590206349b&_e=Mm1k-O4-fgwGHiHTc3eSEcTrvEbfUak_Um9jRRSaHLHkn0XbBYQJUktQsXrvxmsEjInB3s-tTnhVvJ3rFyjE808Egp79Edvq5dwRtAF9DFN3oJqAOptjibyu91QMcMdqVObcjXenxy_LtirjuZqfd832XGW-CNN09eCVGt1S_dbt0U6xSF8FvR4Nd1S-9-LNOTqwv5SsWvbYAFhO_AY94HhHf2FWPvv9laUHsm2Zbj-8FO7CiAyVXUaroT6klyN5) of fentanyl. It’s blatantly obvious—Democrats are willing to look the other way when it comes to legitimate threats to our national sovereignty, homeland security, and economic prosperity... that is until GOP leaders [put the problem in their backyards.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=28bacb2338104a259d5a57590206349b&_e=Mm1k-O4-fgwGHiHTc3eSES1A6r2g_Hrgn9N7r18mcCnRf2NXmMMxmwZm9rcDsxd2fPCS3NV_Cmk5eH34eL1vnRGTlJ6GG8DilFXOuCAWuO-IA8ixc2GcDFSXQYpt-SHV-nSETZ_Zogy9v_HdYjZFWTu0fAulvrJ2LxjUhdxa74j99VJ5RQ5rUKrtlN7qKZ4VtsAIQgrr3sRqGhaMZPhzy7IDwtBPR7uO0byMVqFJj5RMWII_hjB8y4FAmuRehsrlyT_QKZv1HoEnFW9wEBDzNQ%3D%3D) No matter where these illegal immigrants are placed in the U.S., it’s time Joe and Kamala face the music. They took an oath to protect the United States, which means they have to fix the border crisis—now.

subject: Hard work pays off
body:
These counties are standing up. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-9236087?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

It’s been a busy few weeks at The Center.

As the Biden Administration's reckless policies wreak havoc on our economy, the leftist media have done their best to ignore, _or worse_ , obfuscate the grim reality of the border crisis, deep state corruption at the FBI, and the DHS letting national security threats into our country.

That’s why we’ve kept our head down; continuing our fight to secure the border, expose the Mar-A-Lago raid as a politically-motivated hit job, and remind America of the dangers of letting unvetted Afghan refugees into our country.

Putting America First means fighting on multiple fronts. __Let’s__ __dive in__.
---
|
---
| **Nearly Two Dozen Texas Counties and Cities Declare Invasion**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5e6d874e57&e=17913c7d6d)
---

We’ve been sounding the alarm on the border crisis for months. We’ve laid out a clearcut plan where states can declare an invasion and legally engage in immigration enforcement.

Read our full policy brief [here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ece9e8beaa&e=17913c7d6d).

We’ve been evangelists for this plan, organizing press conferences and doing a [media blitz](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=de402563d4&e=17913c7d6d) to promote our policy initiative. And our hard work is paying off!

As fentanyl and hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants pour over the border, our plan to declare an invasion to end the border crisis is gaining steam. **So far, 23 counties and one city in Texas have declared an invasion. **

The legal authority to declare an invasion is clear. CRA Senior Fellow Ken Cuccinelli [explained](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3ff2cd5b05&e=17913c7d6d) how governors could declare an invasion during a Fox News appearance back in July.
|
---
| **CRA’s Jeff Clark on Lou Dobbs: Mar-a-Lago Raid “An Assault on the presidency itself.”**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ba11e3eef7&e=17913c7d6d)
---
CRA Senior Fellow Jeff Clark made a recent [appearance](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=524fef31b6&e=17913c7d6d) on The Great America Show with Lou Dobbs. During the episode, Lou and Jeff discussed the raid on Mar-a-Lago and the erosion of our liberties. One particularly poignant moment were Jeff’s remarks on what this raid really means:

_“It's incredibly alarming. I think what happened in terms of the raid on Mar-a-Lago is an assault not just on Donald Trump personally, whom obviously they've been trying to nail to the wall since you know 2015 maybe, but certainly 2016 forward, it's an assault on the presidency itself.”_

**No one would know these topics better than Jeff.** While working in the Trump administration, he took his concerns about election fraud straight to the president. In return he’s been raided by DOJ agents at his home and been one of the key targets of the January 6th committee’s show trials.

You can listen to the full episode [here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0d7afc9232&e=17913c7d6d).
|
---
| **CRA’s Jeff Clark on Lou Dobbs: Mar-a-Lago Raid “An Assault on the presidency itself.”**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1662091b58&e=17913c7d6d)
---
During the U.S. military pullout from Afghanistan, we warned about the dangers of letting unvetted Afghan refugees into our country.

Here’s what we said back in August of 2021:

_“Americans understandably want to protect the Afghans who risked their lives to fight with the United States against the Taliban and Al-Qaeda. However, we must be careful that we do not allow the attitude behind the self-destructive open border policies and enforcement failures happening on our southern border to be repeated with the importation and resettlement of tens of thousands of Afghans who we cannot properly vet, may very well pose a security risk to our communities, and may be unable or unwilling to assimilate into our country.”_

You can read our full statement on this issue [here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=61bf84253e&e=17913c7d6d).

**Unfortunately, we were right.** Despite assurances from the Biden administration about proper vetting, it looks like our warnings came true.

A recent [article](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=c2d447d303&e=17913c7d6d) from the Washington Times reveals that Biden’s Department of Homeland Security (DHS) allowed unvetted and dangerous Afghans to enter the USA during this time period.

According to the Times, one individual approved to enter the country had just been let out of prison by the Taliban, while another was determined to pose a national security threat by the FBI. Hundreds of individuals were allowed in despite having either no first name, or no last name. Of the 89K vetted, 11K listed the same birthdate of January 1st.

It’s shocking and outrageous but not at all surprising.
| **We’re Not Stopping: How You Can Join the Fight**
---
| The Center for Renewing isn’t just another think tank. We’re fighting 24/7 to stop the left’s destructive agenda.

Whether it’s the border crisis, dismantling the deep state, or stopping election fraud, we’re putting the plans into place that will save our country. And we expect results of ourselves.

That’s why we have the trust and endorsement of President Trump, and why we’re leaders in advancing the America First agenda.

**No one can be left sitting on the sidelines.** Everyone MUST step up to the fight.

[Support the America First movement! Every contribution you make to the Center for Renewing America will go towards saving our country.](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=dd175c2d8f&e=17913c7d6d)

With patriots like you by our side, we know we can win this fight. As always, thank you for your support.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

We’re facing Don Bolduc in the general election
#

It's official, friend — I have my Republican opponent.
We knew that no matter who won, we'd be up against a far-right rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell’s right-wing, anti-choice agenda.
But Don Bolduc goes way beyond that.
[**Before I go any further, I need your immediate help to put us in the strongest possible position. Please split a donation between my campaign and Mark Kelly’s right now to keep this seat (and the Senate) in Democratic hands.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-hassan-sept22.X3hBJz&refcode=em220916-2-subs&t=1&akid=3857%2E6688874%2EWQu04Q)
**[Rush $3](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-hassan-sept22.X3hBJz&refcode=em220916-2-subs&t=2&akid=3857%2E6688874%2EWQu04Q)**
Not only is Don Bolduc a far-right extremist, but he's also an election denier who said he would "defy the [2024] presidential election results" if called to do so.
But it doesn't stop there. Bolduc is open to abolishing the FBI and supports repealing the 17th Amendment, which would strip voters of their right to elect their Senators.
_**This isn't just about keeping this seat blue, it's about the future of our democracy._**
But extreme GOP groups are spending over $53 million on attack ads against me, and it's only a matter of time until the full force of the Republican party floods New Hampshire with millions more to flip this seat.
With _The Boston Globe_ calling me "the most vulnerable senator up for reelection this year" and the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your grassroots support right now could not be more important.
[**I know you've received a lot of emails from me recently, but the first few days of the general election are crucial, and we can't start off on the wrong foot. So please, split a donation between my campaign and Mark Kelly’s to help us defeat Don Bolduc and defend our Democratic Senate majority this November.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-hassan-sept22.X3hBJz&refcode=em220916-2-subs&t=3&akid=3857%2E6688874%2EWQu04Q)

The United States Constitution is a genius document - the _original_ Contract with America.

More than 230 years ago in Philadelphia, 39 delegates to the Constitutional Convention signed the U.S. Constitution on September 17, 1787. This historic event marked an important milestone for our remarkable experiment in self-government.

And ever since, it has successfully guided our system of government and frustrated politicians who want to take away our rights - which it so clearly outlines.

But the Constitution makes Democrats in Washington seethe with anger. They are determined to destroy it and institute Big Government Socialist rule in its place.

This is why it's so important for patriots like you and me to read our Constitution and share copies with our fellow citizens!

Newt Gingrich

* 11:30 AM - 12:00 PM - Meet & Greet
* 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM - Picnic Lunch and Yard Games

Tilden Woods Local Park, 6800 Tilden Ln, Rockville, MD 20852, USAAbout The EventCelebrate the Constitution and Citizenship Day at the Tilden Woods Local Park. Meet Gregory Coll, Christopher Palombi, and others from the Montgomery County GOP, Potomac Women's Republican Club and more. Let’s have an awesome celebration recognizing the adoption of the United States Constitution and all Citizens. This Republican Rally will also serve as a fresh start to the 2022 general election cycle and all primary and general election candidates are welcome. We will have some yard games setup and there will be free food, drinks, and some cake on Saturday September 17th. We will also be giving away t-shirts to the first 100 guests. Children are welcome to attend. If you can’t make it and want to send a campaign donation or follow the campaign progress please visit: [https://www.gregorycoll.com](https://www.gregorycoll.com/so/b3OD7knXC/c?w=XJ_bn9sAmwNe6IOCEUPQTROuX7mxSGZ312LnS5-HIgk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ3JlZ29yeWNvbGwuY29tLyIsInIiOiI2ZWY5YTRlYi01MjI3LTQwYTUtOGVkYS0xMmU3NTAxYTIxOTciLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0ZGUxYmQzYy00ZDBhLTQ1NDEtOGRiMy1kYWYxMWRjZDBlYjEifQ), thanks. | Peter,

Hispanic Heritage month is officially underway, and it’s a special time to pay tribute to the culture and history of our Latino communities. Hispanic Americans have shaped our country, and I’m excited to celebrate the progress we’ve made.

I am a proud Latina, raised by immigrant parents from Mexico. Thanks to their hard work and dedication, they became the only parents in our country’s history to have two daughters serving in Congress!

This is not only a time to celebrate the progress we’ve made. It’s also a time to reflect on the progress that we have yet to make. Our country’s economy cannot be successful without the contributions of Hispanic Americans, and we must address the gaps in education, pay, health care, and more. We must also enact comprehensive immigration reform that includes a path to citizenship so families can stay together.

I hope everyone will join me in celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month while reflecting on the work we still need to do.

Thank you!

Linda

| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=b2ded25cdc454fd5a45c1dea62b16ab8&_e=AlfK07eJhsnw8HyR7-KQkF2AojbGPvHs6_koRm6UN6Z9Bv3iC02anP5aAp8Gf6jTV_BsYMKGAGBf8QE3i6OxykpIfEygAsc13SUvUp6izEFaKdx4iwvgk9nKF7C-UujqGTHCd3euJgdBaQy_nw8pH1D8aLdG_dIm188SiJax-HrhyTOYhgBExGu24gDi5r-399xg6NTQI__Gh5jGsQC0ai684iydxU2pst8S_OJtk53E1_BZ9s1J7WsrtQnP5DH5D9jyu0K9_U2SrgB7d3m_WWT1AVYvaTGUbc8LBK20GKHAIc1BDB_Liw5ZVJu8lK6U)

Peter,

**The same Democrat party that just authorized the unprecedented FBI raid of President Trump’s home over “documents” just voted to give the IRS enough of your hard-earned money to hire 87,000 new IRS agents to come after the rest of us.**

**In what world is 87,000 new IRS agents a priority for our country?**

And I’m doing everything in my power to help.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=907%2E5257348%2EkOSqfr)
Derek, I’ll explain more in a moment, but while I have your attention: **[Will you split a $10 contribution to 10 California Democrats running to expand and defend our House majority this fall?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em_ca_house.Ie-aZT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220916_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=907%2E5257348%2EkOSqfr)**
Here’s what you need to know:
In 2018, California Democrats flipped 7 of the 41 seats Democrats won nationwide to take back the House. Our new Democratic majority went right to work, holding the Trump administration accountable for their many abuses of power.
But that could all change this fall. Despite President Biden’s victory and flipping the Senate, we lost seats in the House in 2020 and now have only a 5-seat House majority. If Republicans take back the House, one of the first things Kevin McCarthy has threatened to do as Speaker is to remove me from my committees and other members as well, in an effort to diminish any accountability. They also threaten to overturn the next election if they lose again, and with such an action, it would mean an end to our democracy.
You and I know we can’t let that happen. So here’s the opportunity:
This is the first congressional election in 10 years to have new district lines. Unlike many states, where right-wing legislatures gerrymander district lines, California has a nonpartisan Citizens Redistricting Commission that actually draws lines fairly.
As a result, 2 of my House colleagues, Mike Levin and Josh Harder, are running in even more difficult districts or races than in 2018 and lack the resources they need to complete their campaign spending plans, while 7 more strong candidates — Kermit Jones, Adam Gray, Rudy Salas, Christy Smith, Dr. Asif Mahmood, Will Rollins, and Jay Chen — are running to flip red-to-blue seats or ones newly opened up in the redistricting process. And I’m doing everything in my power to help.
**Derek, this is a _huge_ opportunity for California to single-handedly save our Democratic majority, but we can’t do this alone. So I’ll ask you plainly:**
**[Will you split a $10 contribution to our 10 campaigns to defend and expand our House majority in California?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sep2022_abs_em_ca_house.Ie-aZT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20220916_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=907%2E5257348%2EkOSqfr)**

Friday, September 16, 2022
---
**CONTACT: Trevor Naglieri**
[Trevor@JeremyShaffer.com](mailto:Trevor@JeremyShaffer.com?subject=Jeremy%20Shaffer%20for%20Congress%20\(PA-17\))
---
| **ICYMI: U.S. Chamber Endorses Jeremy Shaffer for Pennsylvania’s 17th Congressional District**
---
| **Pittsburgh, PA** – Today, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce announced its endorsement of Jeremy Shaffer (R) to represent Pennsylvania’s 17th Congressional District. The Chamber endorses pro-business candidates for federal office who will vigorously support public policy that will advance economic growth, support jobs, and promote fiscal responsibility.

“Jeremy Shaffer is an engineer, entrepreneur, and leader in western Pennsylvania,” said **Ashlee Rich Stephenson, Senior Political Strategist of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce**. “Jeremy knows firsthand the challenges facing small businesses today and will be a bipartisan advocate to get things done in Washington on behalf of Pennsylvania’s 17th District. He has the full endorsement of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and we look forward to partnering with him in Congress.”

“We congratulate Jeremy Shaffer on earning the endorsement of the U.S. Chamber in his race to represent western Pennsylvanians in Congress,” said **Luke Bernstein, President and CEO of the Pennsylvania Chamber of Business and Industry**. “Jeremy has a record of delivering bipartisan solutions as a township commissioner. We know where he stands on the issues, and he will be a leader for pro-business policy in Congress.”

"The U.S. Chamber of Commerce represents businesses of all sizes, across every sector of our economy here in Western Pennsylvania, and it's an honor to earn their support," said **Jeremy Shaffer**. "As a small business owner myself who employed dozens (all 100% American jobs), I am very familiar with the issues important to employers and workers across PA-17 and our nation. In Congress, I'll be a champion for pro-growth policies so businesses, from mom-and-pop shops to large manufacturing companies, can thrive and create meaningful jobs that fuel our western Pennsylvania economy."
---
|
---
_Today's endorsement event, L to R: Bob Doddato, North Fayette Township Supervisor; Jeremy Shaffer; Ashlee Rich Stephenson, Senior Political Strategist of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce; Craig Hennemuth, President of Hennemuth Metal Fabricators._

| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

We wanted to follow up with you on this Peter. If this doesn’t absolutely enrage you, what will?

Instead of finishing Trump’s wall, Biden chose to open the borders. Taking care of the illegal immigrants that have entered this year with cost the taxpayers another $20.4 Billion, added to the $140 Billion already spent for a total of $160.4B.

Here’s what we could have done with the money if Biden had finished the wall instead of opening the border:

* Given every homeless veteran $50,000 per year to end veteran homelessness
* Expanding and funding the National School Lunch Program

clean_body: | | | Friend, I just announced my book tour for my new book, “If You Want Something Done...” I’ll be traveling across the country for two weeks for my book tour and I want you to join me. When I was growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys Club and my opponent thought that women didn’t belong in politics. People thought I was too brown...too female...too young...too conservative...too principled... Well, I said: Too bad! I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. I want to share the stories of these incredible women with you and hope you will be inspired, too. That’s why I wrote this book. Here are the cities I’ll be in: Chicago, IL Palm Beach, FL Vero Beach, FL Southern Pines, NC Myrtle Beach, SC Houston, TX Dallas, TX Los Angeles, CA Atlanta, GA New York, NY I hope to see you there! My very best, Nikki Haley | | | Exclusive Message From Nikki Haley Update on the Next Election I want to give you a quick update on my plans for the next election. Since launching Stand For America PAC we have endorsed, advised, and financially supported more than 55 conservative candidates. Now I’m focused on helping even more Republicans win in the next election, and I want you to play an important part. There’s a question we hear a lot,
Peter:

Exactly how do we plan on defeating Rand Paul?

We‘ve launched an ambitious field program to register voters, show up for
disenfranchised communities, and make sure all of our voices – from the
hood to the holler – are heard this election. But we’re less than 10 weeks
away from Election Day, and we have a lot of work to do.

We’ll dive into the details of our plans in just a moment. For years now,
we’ve been organizing an unprecedented grassroots organizing movement
across Kentucky and we need the resources to make sure we can finally end
Rand Paul’s disastrous rule.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220916.RpnWG-&refcode=em20220916-2490&t=1001&akid=2490%2E346206%2ET8lduh ]Can you take 2 minutes to donate $5 to contribute to our

Let’s start by explaining the situation:

Truth is, there’s a long history of voter suppression in our Commonwealth,
meaning the folks who don’t vote outnumber those who do. Black and brown
communities in particular have long been counted out in our elections.
Kentucky is also one of just a few states with a recently elected
Democratic governor and two Republican senators.

But Peter, the
tides are turning.

Recently, new progressive Democrats like Charles have invested in
successful campaigns that mobilize communities our politicians have
ignored for too long. From the hood to the holler, Charles is building a
level of excitement and enthusiasm we haven’t seen in decades. He isn’t
afraid to advocate for bold solutions to combat the climate crisis, police
violence, and income inequality. He’s a proven leader who knows what
challenges Kentuckians are going through because he’s been there himself.

That’s exactly the kind of candidate we need to defeat Rand Paul, and
that’s exactly why we’re:

* Building a grassroots network of organizers
* Training volunteer coordinators
* Purchasing voter outreach tools
* Printing campaign literature
* Setting up a fund to pay for gas for our teams as they travel across
Kentucky

There are 120 counties in Kentucky and we want to invest in organizers and
volunteers in every single one of them so we can leverage our grassroots
power. We’re building the infrastructure we need to win, but we can’t do
it without you.

We have the momentum and energy to defeat Rand Paul but it’s going to take
hard work from all of us to send Charles to the U.S. Senate. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220916.RpnWG-&refcode=em20220916-2490&t=1021&akid=2490%2E346206%2ET8lduh ]Will you
chip in $5 or anything you can to make sure we turn out the
votes to elect Charles in the next 53 days?

In just a few weeks, we will shock the country with a historic upset never
seen before in Kentucky when we defeat Rand Paul and elect our first
Democratic Senator in decades.

Are you with us?

Team Booker

You can organize with Team AOC from anywhere in the country.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220916-3398-header&t=1&akid=3398%2E2526796%2EKlSjGn)
Just because our district is in New York doesn’t mean we only organize locally! Team AOC is ready to hear from all parts of the nation about how to help create progressive change nationwide!
**That’s why we’re hosting regional meet-ups on Zoom this weekend to meet organizers, staff, and volunteers who can share insights and discuss how to start organizing in your area.**
[It’s crucial that we have as many people join as possible to kick-start local organizing across the country. Will you sign up now for a regional meet-up?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/2918?utm_source=em20220916-3398-P_ORG_VOL_ORG&t=2&akid=3398%2E2526796%2EKlSjGn)

No matter where you live, you can join the mass movement for a just society. We are happy to have you!
See you this weekend,
Team AOC

| | | | | _Hi! Cliff here, and we have a special guest who'd like to speak with you! You probably saw him in a viral clip just the other day, explaining to a clearly flummoxed Republican on CNN that two Supreme Court seats were stolen by Mitch McConnell & Donald Trump, and therefore this Court is illegitimate. _ _So, as they say in the business Al used to be in, Senator Franken, take it away!......._ __ Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email, I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. (Though it’s a really good thing.) **[I want you to give to Josh Riley’s campaign for the open House in seat in NY’s 19th district. And to Blue Amp Action too.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T022e2e7f-ff12-4826-8976-ddfdb8706fe0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some. Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY. After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. Josh is the hardest worker I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend. And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation. **[Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0d1906b9-330e-464d-9fa5-da4eb93508c9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This is important. To me. And to our nation.
