Fellow American,

[**My calling in life is to serve others.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b4d438b0110c4c8490ff90373c7761c6&_e=w_7971CZY1J--YzkBuLjtafLn4k1YzT8kTTNG7DK5oaqj1vr_ZNKsxtGUic1Mqf0ep_Sk_5u_ztgV_2DNT9HKVHcVer7tKIf0-0cjEX5X2e5dxXQWwc4Dlho6RSClMARv8bPtZnTy16_Xlh4nFDGbhgwIrG2QBd_q7DpK06EAb5MrCKsErDZgFtdrZob_XJcf5r0d6AS5tu3uw0_lZ5Zdl79eBcKlWQagCiPsMnhV8muF_Awz0NBvCfaI2WKsrRxb6o5dHpGWvyf7LetdPqBkYBLshurr_Rpgaur_d67D90_R6A0xG_fLKNw57paJ6F1yjJPgpxYaXQDEAoPN3ifHdM2G4By4Kn9fkwlcWh8M54KfrhwRlozFOqDrOlxYMeEoBqEE5tq9bjoJRLIjKt-Q-BdR508kpT5lVGdSxrlqYA%3D)

**_Service to my country, service to my family, service to all Americans._**

It’s one of the reasons I joined the Marine Corps – to do something that mattered, beyond myself. Something that would help people. I served nine years in the Marine Corps, four overseas tours, and remain in the reserves – ready to help if I’m needed.

When I got home, I became increasingly concerned about the direction our country was headed in and I knew I had to jump in and to help, so I hopped into a congressional race in a swing district with no resources, knowledge, or background in politics.

I knew things would be tough, but as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington!

[**SEND IN THE MARINE » **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b4d438b0110c4c8490ff90373c7761c6&_e=w_7971CZY1J--YzkBuLjtafLn4k1YzT8kTTNG7DK5oaqj1vr_ZNKsxtGUic1Mqf0ep_Sk_5u_ztgV_2DNT9HKVHcVer7tKIf0-0cjEX5X2e5dxXQWwc4Dlho6RSClMARv8bPtZnTy16_Xlh4nFDGbhgwIrG2QBd_q7DpK06EAb5MrCKsErDZgFtdrZob_XJcf5r0d6AS5tu3uw0_lZ5Zdl79eBcKlWQagCiPsMnhV8muF_Awz0NBvCfaI2WKsrRxb6o5dHpGWvyf7LetdPqBkS2YGbDeDvrrMaxTVMyU-wuu7UnJwGYbpb5lM5LAL8dtinjM2ENb1UvC-65DNPDFsyQ-Mk671H-DbLR4EpTLaewL8BXmdNtx-JBZOGWIILE_RRpwniMGh0jU2-lNxQ_USYpl7bn2PUZFy0kW7ehfm00%3D)
In case you were wondering why you may not have heard from me before now, it’s **because I lost in 2020 by less than 11,000 votes** in what became one of the closest congressional races in the 2020 election.

I’m running to unseat the same Pelosi-approved Democrat once again and just like last time, this race will be _very_ close. That’s probably why both sides have labeled this as a top-targeted race. [**In a district with as many Republican voters as Democrats, this race could really go either way._That’s why I need you._

Will you join my team via contribution of $2, maybe $3 today?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b4d438b0110c4c8490ff90373c7761c6&_e=w_7971CZY1J--YzkBuLjtafLn4k1YzT8kTTNG7DK5oaqj1vr_ZNKsxtGUic1Mqf0ep_Sk_5u_ztgV_2DNT9HKVHcVer7tKIf0-0cjEX5X2e5dxXQWwc4Dlho6RSClMARv8bPtZnTy16_Xlh4nFDGbhgwIrG2QBd_q7DpK06EAb5MrCKsErDZgFtdrZob_XJcf5r0d6AS5tu3uw0_lZ5Zdl79eBcKlWQagCiPsMnhV8muF_Awz0NBvCfaI2WKsrRxb6o5dHpGWvyf7LetdPqBkTllyoJjC7Ns2hObKguEWAVDJQ-dAzZz59RoxqjwNVsA-KgcURgOyGLt8I4doSV3HMJ7sNwrLU0DNpx9TlJriiP-qeplEbp9b22Pm-a4RhzBFsgaInZ3ufPz-ug7CEie1LWJSjeOGZXZNHSlGLlRdms%3D)

[**FLIP A TOSSUP HOUSE SEAT » **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b4d438b0110c4c8490ff90373c7761c6&_e=w_7971CZY1J--YzkBuLjtafLn4k1YzT8kTTNG7DK5oaqj1vr_ZNKsxtGUic1Mqf0ep_Sk_5u_ztgV_2DNT9HKVHcVer7tKIf0-0cjEX5X2e5dxXQWwc4Dlho6RSClMARv8bPtZnTy16_Xlh4nFDGbhgwIrG2QBd_q7DpK06EAb5MrCKsErDZgFtdrZob_XJcf5r0d6AS5tu3uw0_lZ5Zdl79eBcKlWQagCiPsMnhV8muF_Awz0NBvCfaI2WKsrRxb6o5dHpGWvyf7LetdPqBkRkIHOXIbkSvZzM-bQnSTvEJpWZwRBGHXOEO5-BA9bs1qMowYdgs0Wjd4oOq930y3jSYftFkuwmzy2bIsafNDAHARTtO5i_q0NcLrj1m9pJqlXNS-eOP7D5NCPLXqbze-hzyqwCwe8_Ood_i1Ljlwmw%3D)
[**I’m running for Congress for one reason: to serve the American people.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b4d438b0110c4c8490ff90373c7761c6&_e=w_7971CZY1J--YzkBuLjtafLn4k1YzT8kTTNG7DK5oaqj1vr_ZNKsxtGUic1Mqf0ep_Sk_5u_ztgV_2DNT9HKVHcVer7tKIf0-0cjEX5X2e5dxXQWwc4Dlho6RSClMARv8bPtZnTy16_Xlh4nFDGbhgwIrG2QBd_q7DpK06EAb5MrCKsErDZgFtdrZob_XJcf5r0d6AS5tu3uw0_lZ5Zdl79eBcKlWQagCiPsMnhV8muF_Awz0NBvCfaI2WKsrRxb6o5dHpGWvyf7LetdPqBkezQ2jLJ8hdN7_QeMEdqb5C_r6yTNbkGbHyK2gvdan6st1U_n7N5a4OaN2Z4sL1i9yzj7fEP73nmnTroZITUJZQgnBB_oJ2z5TF6zobogKZOiQCAkHiVJFCTdKQv7AIN5F1dEhkhlCBeUabeLvwHMcQ%3D) I’m never going to be the loudest conservative in the House – nor the most colorful – but I’ll put my head down and work diligently to get the work of the people done. _**Isn’t that worth something anymore?**_

The Marines taught me to never give up and that everything is achievable if one works hard enough for it. Over the past two years I’ve laid in bed wondering what might have been if I had an adequately funded campaign. I’ll never know.

I do know that I’m running against the same Democrat who beat me in 2020 and this race is likely going to be even closer than the one from two years ago. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today: **I’d hate to get so close to victory again and run out of money just before Election Day.**

name: Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=669dc21ca2ad42ebbf501503f8c70861&_e=VwLR9MRod4D8lfc6xCuF4z-q80SL2FGVyF3lIt24zonMFsIst7mHNgx4SAWXBQUNEohXQO_Rfj55dZv8f7f0yFXuFf7uji3J8_rfZhuax54Il0-aKviCPpdQh9Kh5OxBSFV4w2NrujKN0YSA9t7a1n6kCMwry0dXokBzzh6BhwJmpD4WEy-TwmfflYeDqbOVUQSDmWI4pC2xgJu2ECZ9YhzyBxuDcHhbduYRU7hQrueYrSZLCfnMsc_dWvyI4Ps-hBMwuDuDfaYvHIq9cFLXCakVdI4EnWb2YDv-5JxzlSy7PMH47ruvx_VjqqNn3XkDbYPglZhVn-89uQm840A4nhT33JBBZEHVqNVho5N83WWPIX4uT7AQkNxt69CAtpNNpRUCLyUpmpNatdNrQ3CpxA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=669dc21ca2ad42ebbf501503f8c70861&_e=VwLR9MRod4D8lfc6xCuF4z-q80SL2FGVyF3lIt24zonMFsIst7mHNgx4SAWXBQUNEohXQO_Rfj55dZv8f7f0yFXuFf7uji3J8_rfZhuax54Il0-aKviCPpdQh9Kh5OxBSFV4w2NrujKN0YSA9t7a1n6kCMwry0dXokBzzh6BhwJmpD4WEy-TwmfflYeDqbOVUQSDmWI4pC2xgJu2ECZ9YhzyBxuDcHhbduYRU7hQrucxomW_Obnf9aW4n9yVAdgdH-oW5JLpur7VCoBFj2QqvQPEEX3e_an9nzk5xeHGMbLrufR4v8eExCNdpNQo3Lvwm3zLZ_6wIc05R0oKltHH9M0UV9R36Wx2kRa1vgi1TIIxnV1hfvpivvhKVqHH2AlL-eefAjR0lvwJ9juFUihrWg%3D%3D)**
For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College.
**And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.**
So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.
**You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=669dc21ca2ad42ebbf501503f8c70861&_e=VwLR9MRod4D8lfc6xCuF4z-q80SL2FGVyF3lIt24zonMFsIst7mHNgx4SAWXBQUNEohXQO_Rfj55dZv8f7f0yFXuFf7uji3J8_rfZhuax54Il0-aKviCPpdQh9Kh5OxBSFV4w2NrujKN0YSA9t7a1n6kCMwry0dXokBzzh6BhwJmpD4WEy-TwmfflYeDqbOVUQSDmWI4pC2xgJu2ECZ9YhzyBxuDcHhbduYRU7hQrufS7GcVvLrmoDpM1FgQPxNYJfZs0hadigO8boeKxmk9H4lmDCzE7tMpQwnNZzJkWToqdGyJOxqdeeCFd_XsCE2sSyXlUGOEUN2Cqo354g0fYudS19KUS3Cd_BV0QvEsP7PJyD2j7tdp3MkCvM4Iy8hfUXghYXC3unnIRN1Vj6v2og%3D%3D)**
And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.
Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.
Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter,

**They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting.** The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because **they're somehow _still_ not sure that I'm worth the investment. **

Instead of putting money into my race, **they're spending millions on seats we can't win.** But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; **here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.**

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 14 days to go, we’re still short about $60,000. **[If you’re in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=0cab193b969048a8a230495a7b1f0647&_e=6yfzsZRlKW6fSbBsVQQ09KjaugNCrbuguuTWbo9drwMUr-V0OgD4XQixOwwLDjT-zJMPu101Mr6cUlK0aYJAV9SgF6fZR2-Nsv6tCbv5aRmWWXU0xqqpO6GSXey-gvYGTCRBbwAPW8edy5mla4-51ZKTQ3tHOtOJuh4EcllmglA-qkkwKvS8SuyPuC6137nhhHklFCynz-ziqsVIFbsN23_2eA2fLZSlJSTLaeBPMQBDFH2JY2UxpQqRfBulUF8WBUrZT_FJ4Ov4JW9JC7cP8ZXPl768HFM0uL9f3PsYen4VUAlchCgR4zmD14b56OYTZefwn7yXgvoaPJZwKA2ZwPWLWuhjhyCIV63pb6jXhSLrlUkZdqTpRQTqNBp-bDy8rXZ0ZAA12EKWszfFs1IQww%3D%3D)**

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=0cab193b969048a8a230495a7b1f0647&_e=6yfzsZRlKW6fSbBsVQQ09KjaugNCrbuguuTWbo9drwMUr-V0OgD4XQixOwwLDjT-zJMPu101Mr6cUlK0aYJAV9SgF6fZR2-Nsv6tCbv5aRmWWXU0xqqpO6GSXey-gvYGTCRBbwAPW8edy5mla4-51ZKTQ3tHOtOJuh4EcllmglA-qkkwKvS8SuyPuC6137nhhHklFCynz-ziqsVIFbsN23_2eA2fLZSlJSTLaeBPMQBDFH2JY2UxpQqRfBulUF8WHM8WvX3NIN_QZ-NlIbosSkttH7JtgfTxqrMnK_fpTAzSCwDTeEWpMH9hn9pWeRoHLBIIH88URXpzQp3PfES_GP8SzfGIHn7xi6W8PGWMxJw9POVdRUOTRRUdyyoPpyO-kLDogPWiLJbLNGHPeZgjFg%3D%3D)

Whether it’s a test or not - I’m not taking any chances. While Oregon’s 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, **it’s ripe for the picking now that he is _finally _retiring__**.

**[If you’re on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=0cab193b969048a8a230495a7b1f0647&_e=6yfzsZRlKW6fSbBsVQQ09KjaugNCrbuguuTWbo9drwMUr-V0OgD4XQixOwwLDjT-zJMPu101Mr6cUlK0aYJAV9SgF6fZR2-Nsv6tCbv5aRmWWXU0xqqpO6GSXey-gvYGTCRBbwAPW8edy5mla4-51ZKTQ3tHOtOJuh4EcllmglA-qkkwKvS8SuyPuC6137nhhHklFCynz-ziqsVIFbsN23_2eA2fLZSlJSTLaeBPMQBDFH2JY2UxpQqRfBulUF8WxsOBzsVF8UrFm_08js8XQgpsSJQEwD2-xSOJ2cyrzyJyVOW-XUbXMv141GIL8oRQWlD_L9WgmruVGM2nq2zWX1BZlwBNt5jHR2N7g-sifm6-GD4naXhlgl90mW2VkXtJdPHmE5L5O1-VEyOfdJK40w%3D%3D)**

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3eade40cb413472696ad6a06c6737076&_e=owRAHoSRW8zD48MgDkL3GjkGrZl_8bhml8fXO9rrN6-iAd4IPmu6mbL8uuk_NsQyuHnSbH56vBLV5ZvLSQE0er5aTCB2XD2DVIO9K5s_XjYtaBvfGR4EzKksjzAX_lDgj1-Rq2kgKhLlIAErFVikMZkNW0gDmca6Hy5JtHfbO5YLps9WGOeCOTM9mhvsc8xlRdjD2kLGl5AmfXlrACvcLn38rdOVPV3ApYjTSME6fdAS5Hd--d9ipe0IxSEjwpZPHOyIltBCt6qYJe1W7BHYJeaPMQyH49ddNFxWhHjMc4h5pPCwiWne0NO9IsjNKqiKGJ3THmy4vO_8cFv8U_6yjzpMlkJJY82y6j3Ev4KPZSSLWV4AzRBE2f8fvoDv-WKqaCyLNAQM5-HKiquEPXIJ6Ts74awOiZgj2fzAFA1KdE0%3D "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. Yep. I had a fangirl moment this week.

Melissa Harris-Perry (yes, her!) interviewed me on The Takeaway, as part of her series dedicated to women running for office.

We talked about the challenges working mothers face who run for office, the magnitude of my work and Congresswoman Karen Bass’ endorsement of me (HUGE!), and my vision for the district. We had a good time. She even said I took her breath away (fan girl, fan girl).

[You can listen to the entire show here](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=74c53ab103&e=e6ba7d1bc4). I come on at the 15 minute mark.

I am so excited that my candidacy is finding its way to the national stage, but I also **need to win** so that we can get to the national stage and make democracy work for us all.

That's where you come in.[ I am asking you to contribute to this campaign ](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=ae193538c0&e=e6ba7d1bc4)so _**we**_ can make that happen.

body:
Peter’s ready to serve each and every one of us on Day One:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=941%2E61531%2EcqVzhs)
Hello,
This movement we’re building is being powered by grassroots supporters. And the endorsements we’ve been lucky to earn from Vermont students, educators, community leaders, and folks from all walks of life are all proof of that. People across our state—from Moretown to Arlington, Charlotte to White River Junction—are all making their voices heard about why we need Peter Welch as our next senator.
Let’s take a look at what we’re hearing from the Welch Wagon:
“**Peter strikes just the right balance** in his demeanor: he is always looking for ways to build bridges across the aisle, but he also has the courage of his convictions.”
-Stephanie, Arlington, VT
“I have known Peter for over 40 years. **He is a tried-and-true Vermonter who has and will continue to work hard for ALL Vermonters.** ”
-Eugene, Rutland, VT
“**Peter is a man who walks his talk.** He lives out the values that I treasure as a Vermonter: the importance of community. It would be a comfort and an honor to have Peter represent me in the U.S. Senate.”
-Susan, Moretown, VT
“**Peter Welch has been a humble champion of Vermonters for decades.** We are lucky to have him in our corner.”
-Helen, Burlington, VT
“These are wildly uncertain times. **We need level headed representation in Congress and Peter is just that.** ”
-James, Charlotte, VT
This is just a small sample of what people on this team are saying, but all the messages echo the same thing: Peter has done a terrific job as Vermont’s congressman by listening to people and focusing on solutions. And it’s how he’ll get things done if Vermont elects him senator. Because _that’s_ the _Vermont way_.
Everything we’ve been able to accomplish up until now has only been possible because of your support. And since this open seat in Vermont could be the difference between passing our positive progressive agenda and Mitch McConnell controlling the Senate again, we need to show the strength and size of this grassroots team. **[So we’re asking: Will you add your name to publicly endorse Peter for the U.S. Senate?](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-endorsement?source=em_20220916_p_t_endorse&t=3&akid=941%2E61531%2EcqVzhs)**

---
Thanks so much,
Welch for Vermont

body:

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26000?t=6&akid=4537%2E878179%2EmaPDQA) We wish we could say we’re surprised – _but this is exactly what we expected from the likes of MAGA Sen. Lindsey Graham._

**It’s clear** – we can’t let Republicans take our Senate majority. _It would be a disaster._

[**So we’re asking pro-choice Democrats across the country to sign on to our letter and commit to fight back to keep our Senate majority. Sign now! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26000?t=7&akid=4537%2E878179%2EmaPDQA) | [Donate $5 to sign the letter and do your part to defend the Senate! »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26000?t=8&akid=4537%2E878179%2EmaPDQA)

****SENDING AT 9AM SHARP****
**TO:** Senator Lindsey Graham **FROM:** A pro-choice Democrat **SUBJECT:** Your awful abortion ban

Dear Sen. Lindsey Graham,

I’m appalled by your proposed national abortion ban. It’s not just idiotic – it directly puts pregnant people’s lives at risk across the country.

Republicans said reproductive rights should be left to the states – and then you turn around and introduce a national ban. _It’s hypocritical, and I’m appalled._

[**I’m so furious, I’m signing this letter today by chipping in $5 to VPP, and committing to make sure Republicans never have a Senate majority – so you can never pass extreme bans like this one! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26000?t=9&akid=4537%2E878179%2EmaPDQA) | [Donate $5 to sign the letter and do your part to defend the Senate! »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/26000?t=10&akid=4537%2E878179%2EmaPDQA)

Team,
I want to tell you a quick story about the difference between my campaign and Mike DeWine’s – and why **[I urgently need your help to win this race.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50843259/367355677/-1174581802?refcode=nw_em_220916_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGY4Y2NhZi0xNDM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wDxNKZD9xq3njnbTwL4l-z1jLl6WsoSMCc6OzgYdrjE=)**
I grew up in a union family. I’m the daughter of my dad who was an autoworker and my mom who worked at the laundromat behind our house to help make ends meet when my dad got laid off. I live in a pretty regular Ohio house – it’s where we filmed one of our ads. (This is my kitchen, featuring my dog, Louis!)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50843260/367355678/-1174581802?refcode=nw_em_220916_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGY4Y2NhZi0xNDM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wDxNKZD9xq3njnbTwL4l-z1jLl6WsoSMCc6OzgYdrjE=)
My opponent is a millionaire with a personal mansion – one that literally has its own Wikipedia page. He doesn't understand what it’s like to deal with rising costs and stagnant wages.
He’s not going to bed worried about how he’ll pay for groceries and rent or a mortgage. But he does have a slew of rich corporate friends bankrolling his campaign to rig the rules against working people.
These are the very same corporate friends he’s spent his years in office cozying up to, through corruption and pay-to-play schemes that have left Ohioans on the hook for billions of dollars in corporate bailouts. They’re not only out-of-touch with how most Ohioans are living, they’re expecting that Ohio taxpayers will foot the bill.
**We can change all that when we win this year –** new polling shows us in a virtual tie with Mike DeWine. But with outside spending coming in fast, we’re playing catch-up to ensure we have the resources to stay competitive.
**[Our campaign relies on those $5 and $10 and $25 donations from people like you who are ready to work together for change. Will you pitch in now so we can reach as many voters as possible about our vision for Ohio – one where all, not just the wealthy and well-connected, can succeed?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50843261/367355679/-1174581802?refcode=nw_em_220916_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGY4Y2NhZi0xNDM2LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wDxNKZD9xq3njnbTwL4l-z1jLl6WsoSMCc6OzgYdrjE=)**

Nan

**The Economic Blueprint for Our Nation 📋**
Over the last few years, you’ve heard about legislative signings like the _Inflation Reduction Act_ , the _CHIPS and Science Act_ , and more. All of this legislation comes on top of President Biden, Vice President Harris, and congressional Democrats’ work to spur the strongest and most equitable economic market recovery in modern history -- _on the heels of a pandemic no less_.
But with so much happening, it can be hard to condense all the information.
So that’s why we’re sharing the Biden-Harris Economic Blueprint and these five pillars:
1️⃣ **Empowering Workers** , with more, good-paying jobs and greater worker power to unionize and have dignity at work.
2️⃣ **Making and Building It in America** , by investing in infrastructure, making America the world’s leader in clean energy jobs and innovation, bolstering our manufacturing base, and buying American.
3️⃣ **Giving Families Breathing Room** , by lowering costs and expanding access to prescription drugs and high-quality health care, high-speed internet, education, child care and long-term care, housing, and other essential needs.
**4️⃣ Making American Industry More Competitive, Less Concentrated, and More Resilient** , by taking on corporate concentration, promoting small businesses and entrepreneurs including minority and women owned businesses, and supporting resilient supply chains.
5️⃣ **Rewarding Work, Not Wealth** , with worker-centric tax reform that ensures the wealthy and large corporations pay their fair share, while never raising taxes on households with incomes below $400,000, as was done in the _Inflation Reduction Act_.
**This is the blueprint we’re fighting for this November and beyond. Learn more about how Democrats are fighting for working people and families -- not the ultra-wealthy and special interests.**

clean_body: Read on for some more updates from the past week as well as some upcoming opportunities for you to get involved ahead of this November’s elections. | | | With the days getting shorter and the temperature getting lower, fall is just around the corner. 🍂 As we close out this summer with you, we thought now would be the perfect opportunity to remind you how much the Biden-Harris Team and Democrats across the nation have accomplished during these past few months. | | | Read on for some more updates from the past week as well as some upcoming opportunities for you to get involved ahead of this November’s elections → A Historical Unveiling There are few things better than a good reunion. That’s why we were so excited last week to watch President Obama and Michelle Obama pay a visit to the White House. The Obamas joined President Biden and Jill Biden for the unveiling of their official White House portraits. Take a look: The Economic Blueprint for Our Nation 📋 Over the last few years, you’ve heard about legislative signings like the Inflation Reduction Act , the CHIPS and Science Act , and more. All of this legislation comes on top of President Biden, Vice President Harris, and congressional Democrats’ work to spur the strongest and most equitable economic market recovery in modern history -- on the heels of a pandemic no less. But with so much happening, it can be hard to condense all the information. So that’s why we’re sharing the Biden-Harris Economic Blueprint and these five pillars: 1️⃣ Empowering Workers , with more, good-paying jobs and greater worker power to unionize and have dignity at work. 2️⃣ Making and Building It in America , by investing in infrastructure, making America the world’s leader in clean energy jobs and innovation, bolstering our manufacturing base, and buying American. 3️⃣ Giving Families Breathing Room , by lowering costs and expanding access to prescription drugs and high-quality health care, high-speed internet, education, child care and long-term care, housing, and other essential needs. 4️⃣ Making American Industry More Competitive, Less Concentrated, and More Resilient , by taking on corporate concentration, promoting small businesses and entrepreneurs including minority and women owned businesses, and supporting resilient supply chains. 5️⃣ Rewarding Work, Not Wealth , with worker-centric tax reform that ensures the wealthy and large corporations pay their fair share, while never raising taxes on households with incomes below $400,000, as was done in the Inflation Reduction Act. This is the blueprint we’re fighting for this November and beyond. Learn more about how Democrats are fighting for working people and families -- not the ultra-wealthy and special interests. | | Warm up with a special deal from the DNC store Peter, as the temperature drops, we’ll be switching out our iced tea for hot cider and cocoa. And what better way to make that switch than with a brand new collection of Democratic mugs? | | There is no better time to get involved: Less than 60 days. That’s how long we have to do whatever it takes to elect Democrats up and down the ballot. We’re doing everything we can to defeat extreme Republicans across the map and continue building a better America. It’s going to be a lot of work. So that’s why we’re coming to you with a few opportunities to get involved. Click below to sign up for an upcoming phone banking session or a community organizing event (or even better, do both!) | | | | It’s coming down to the wire and your support is critical → Peter -- abortion rights, voting rights, gun safety reform, LGBTQ+ rights, climate action, affordable health care, and more are all on the ballot this November. We have a choice whether we want to move forward or go backward. That’s why we need your support. Your generous donations play a key role in the success of Democrats nationwide. This November is about protecting the rights that we hold dear not only for ourselves, but for our families and loved ones. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines.
